THE THIRD STEP. 49

Hear those who philosophize in a heathen or profane manner as if they were frogs, not nightingales <note>original: "ranas, non philomelas" — a metaphor comparing the repetitive, harsh croaking of worldly logic to the sweet, melodic song of divine truth.</note>. Let him who can grasp this—provided the devil does not block him—grasp it and mend his ways. **[From the stranger]** who is foreign, Greek, and lying, and who is not confirmed by the internal testimony of the Holy Spirit. The reason for this is that Wisdom is not acquired through the painted and showy words of Rhetoric <note>original: "fucatis & phaleratis" — terms suggesting artificial makeup and the decorative ornaments of a horse's harness; used here to describe deceptive, over-embellished speech.</note>, nor through the twisting paths of syllogisms <note><term>syllogism</term>: a form of logical argument where a conclusion is drawn from two given premises (e.g., All men are mortal; Socrates is a man; therefore Socrates is mortal).</note>. With these tricks, this "Foreign Woman" entices the young and the unwary into her love—which is, alas, a shameful and harlot-like love! Instead, Wisdom comes by the Light of a mind divinely illuminated through "Enthusiasm" <note>original: "Enthuſiaſticè" — in this context, it refers to its literal Greek root meaning "filled with God" or direct divine inspiration, rather than the modern sense of excitement.</note> falling upon the intellect and moving the free will to believe. This is the most noble way of knowing all things.

**Who softens her words**] She does this through Dialectics <note>the art of investigating the truth of opinions through logical discussion</note> and Rhetoric. Seneca said: A flattering speech is honeyed poison. He who believes too easily is easily deceived. Therefore Cicero rightly said: The strength and sinews of Wisdom consist in not believing easily. And Euripides: Nothing is better or more useful to men than prudent distrust. Therefore, learn now,

## OF THE SECOND STEP. 51

*The ways of man, etc.*] When your soul gapes for worldly things—honors, pleasures, riches—your ways are perverse, and you deviate from the **HIGHEST GOOD**. *He considers his steps*] Your pursuits, counsels, ruses, snares, cunning, and your foolish desires are your "steps," which the Lord considers; the Angels behold; the conscience accuses and observes; and the devils count. **GOD**, who searches the hearts and reins <note>A biblical idiom referring to the innermost thoughts and emotions.</note> of all, and understands every thought of the mind (1 Chronicles 28:9), abhors the depravity of the heart and (unless you repent) delivers it to the avenging creatures who exercise vengeance against all whom **GOD** abhors. The greatest misery, indeed hell itself, is to be abandoned by **GOD**.

*Iniquities*] Every iniquity inflicts punishments and blows upon itself: there is no vice that does not produce its own peculiar disease. <margin>True Wisdom frees the soul from Folly</margin> For just as virtue itself is its own most beautiful reward, so indeed every vice is its own worst reward. For every seed brings forth its own proper fruit. The fruit of mercy is mercy; the reward of kindness is kindness; and conversely, the fruit of unmercifulness is unmercifulness and cruelty. *He is bound by the cords of his sins*] Sin is certainly the greatest servitude and captivity, binding the wicked man so that he cannot escape punishment. Divine Wisdom is a noble freedom which frees the soul of man from the chains of folly, from the errors of darkness, from the blows of vices, and from the snares of despair.

*He shall go astray*] The human soul, not illuminated by the light of Divine Wisdom, is so full of errors that not even the smallest of its actions is free from error. In short, it cannot look upon the smallest star of Heaven, nor a tiny herb of the earth, without error, because all its thoughts are errors. This is truly the "multitude of folly," which can bring nothing other than death and destruction with it. I desire a son of **WISDOM**—that is, one who is attentive, driven by the sting of the ray of the Sun of Divine illumination, humble in mind and gentle—not a premature know-it-all or an arrogant man, which is to say, a sophist <note>The author distinguishes between the "Wise" seeker and the "Sophist" who uses clever but empty logic for prestige</note>.

42 INTERPRETATIONS

<margin>The divine thing might not be in one; therefore <unclear>something</unclear> to <unclear>something</unclear> which may be through one.</margin>

Our mind [ascending] into the heavens is not, believe me, the work of a single day. We must migrate step by step from evil to **Good**; from corporeal to **Spiritual**; from the sensible to the **Mental**; from earthly to **Divine** things, if we wish to be capable of receiving the Good, the Spiritual, and the Divine. These are the steps of the ascensions. See verse 218.
**She herself goes about, etc.**] This means she searches everywhere; she seeks in every part of the earth, at every time and place, to find whether there might be someone who truly holds true WISDOM in their heart, so that she may signify and declare her concern and benevolence toward her faithful and beloved lovers in reality—that is, by communicating her infinite treasures to them. <margin>98</margin> See verses 142, 144, 160. If you seek WISDOM, you will be sought and magnetically attracted by her in turn: you shall find and be found. <note>original German: "Wie man ſich gegen ſie erzeigt vnd verhelt / alſo ſie auch hinwiderumb."</note> *As one presents and conducts oneself toward her, so she behaves in return.* **In the ways.**] What are these ways? None other than the Books of Holy Scripture, of Nature, and of our own Mind <margin>The triple Book shows the way of Wisdom</margin> purified in a Christian manner through repentance (verse 61). In these ways of WISDOM, I say, as we walk wisely—if we pray **Theosophically** <term>Theosophically: Using "divine wisdom" to harmonize spiritual insight with natural observation.</term> and if we labor wisely—DIVINE WISDOM shows herself to us in a marvelous and wondrous fashion. See verse 48. **In every thought, etc.**] By their opinion, judgment, and the concept of the mind, she is kindly grasped and formed. For the word used in this place is *phantazesthai* <note>Greek: φαντάζεσθαι</note>, which means "to imagine" or "to form something in the thought and mind." Thus WISDOM says that she dwells in their minds and thoughts in such a way that she shows and communicates herself to them in a friendly manner. The human being who sees GOD is the one to whom GOD appears, to whom He offers Himself to be seen, and to whom the WISDOM OF GOD represents herself. This is not something that happens in a common way, but rather in the mirrors of Holy Scripture, Nature, and the Mind when they have been **Theosophically** washed and cleansed. Verse 336. The Divine Power <term>Numen: A Latin term for a presiding divinity or divine will.</term> that thrives in man is immense and cannot be valued enough. Man, excelling in reason, rules over the Creatures (by the will and command of GOD) in such a way that he does not merely use what is present out of necessity, but also wanders through more remote and secret things, using and enjoying his Genius and natural talent under the guidance of GOD. And indeed, it is a thing worthy of wonder, what the passing of time—which tests and instructs—brings forth! Or rather, what that **Reason** and **the Word** <note>Greek: ὁ λόγος (ho logos)</note> plants within this mortal little worm! To whom He has given the ability to know all eternity and the breadth, height, and depth of the whole worldly machine: so that by knowing the created things, he may observe the Creator, and may hear and understand this Metaphysical summit—the living principle of the rational mind. Let him grasp this whole world through reason; let him cultivate it with the mind, and breathe it with sensible vigor: let whatever exists be for Him. And finally, leaving behind sagacious human Philosophy, let him strive to **return to his true homeland** <term>patrizare: To act like one's father or to return to the fatherland; here, returning the soul to its divine origin.</term>. For all things that He had made were very good. May GOD grant it, let every lover of WISDOM say, Amen.

*When he established the heavens above*] <note>Proverbs 8:28</note> When he established the ethereal Spirit—that is, the Heaven, created in Genesis 1:1—and thus constituted the <term>Firmament<note>The 'firmament' was understood by early modern scholars as a solid or fixed expanse that separated the waters above from the waters below.</note></term> by his Word, making it solid according to Genesis 1:6. Therefore, let the vanities of certain <term>sciolists<note>From the Latin 'sciolus', referring to those who possess only a superficial smattering of knowledge yet pretend to expertise.</note></term> vanish, who tell tales that the entire **NATURE** of the whole worldly machine is, in our times, not as vigorous, healthy, unharmed, and strong as it was in the age of our ancestors or fathers: claiming that the Heaven, by falling, has lowered itself by 8,000 miles; that the Sun, Moon, and Stars have lost much of their pristine light; that Herbs, flowers, fruits, etc., and the Animals of the earth, water, and air, are not of such virtue, efficacy, or operation today as they were a hundred or a thousand years ago. Indeed, they claim that Nature is even now, from day to day, totally weakened by old age, and that its strengths are broken on account of our sins.

It would be a great word, if it were true. If you understood, my Lords, the **NATURE OF NATURE** <note>original: "NATVRÆ NATVRAM", a philosophical term for the creative principle or essence behind the physical world.</note>—that is, what it is, what its Being is, and how great and of what kind its Law is, by whom it was implanted in the Creature, and for what use—you would speak differently. As for what pertains to Heaven, tell me, I pray, have you ever observed a circumference that has been established circularly fall toward the center? Do you not read, *By the **WORD OF THE LORD** the heavens were established: and all the power of them by the spirit of his mouth* (Psalm 33:6)? And, *Let there be a Firmament: and GOD called the firmament, heaven* (Genesis 1:8). If it had fallen, what kind of firmament would it be? A "distinguished" one, indeed! O, such a "remarkable" establishment of the heavens by the **WORD OF THE LORD**! O, you sciolists! Furthermore, GOD said: *Let there be lights in the firmament of the Heaven, and let them divide the day and the night: and let them be for signs and seasons, and days and years: that they may shine, and illuminate the earth.* And it was so: *And GOD made two great lights: a greater light to rule the day, and a lesser light to rule the night: and the stars* (Genesis 1:14 onwards). Is this not the power of the Heavens, established by the Spirit of the mouth of **JEHOVAH**? Who in their right mind will deny that the Sun, Moon, and Stars divide the day and night, serve for signs and seasons, days and years, shine and illuminate the earth, and rule the day and night just as well even today as they did a thousand years ago?

Where the thing itself speaks, what need is there for a longer proof? The Voice of GOD: *LET THE EARTH SPROUT green herb, and such as yields seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit according to its kind, whose seed is in itself upon the earth;* LET THE *Waters BRING FORTH the creeping thing of a living soul, and the winged creature above the Earth under the firmament of Heaven;* LET THE *Earth BRING FORTH the living soul in its kind, cattle and creeping things, and beasts of the Earth according to their species.* This Voice of GOD, I say, in Genesis 1 was fulfilled; and having been **BROUGHT FORTH**, by the Divine Blessing, **INCREASE AND MULTIPLY**, being animated and strengthened, they have increased and been multiplied from the very beginning of the World. They increase and are multiplied at this very day; they shall increase (by the vigor of the **LAW** once and for all Divinely implanted) and shall be multiplied, even until the renovation of the whole World through **FIRE**. The **WORD OF THE LORD** remains forever (Isaiah chapter 40, verse 8). *So shall my **WORD** be,* says **JEHOVAH** (Isaiah chapter 55, verse 11), *which goes out from my mouth: it shall not return to me empty, but it shall do whatever I have willed, and shall prosper in those things for which I sent it.* <note>original German: "Wächst derentwegen heutiges Tages noch gleich also gut Graß / als vor tausendt Jahren."</note> Therefore, grass still grows today just as well as it did a thousand years ago. Tell me, I pray, what of this? *Heaven is my seat, but the Earth is my footstool* (Isaiah chapter 66, verse 1).

## The Third Degree

Avoid frivolous, obscene, impious, blasphemous, base, and foolish conversations, or buffoonery that is irrelevant, as described in Ephesians 5:4. And shun slanderous words, which rage and lash out scabrously at one's neighbor. Whoever seeks true wisdom should flee these things and be utterly estranged from them. As the learned Erasmus piously says, "A rotten corpse lies in the tomb of the heart, from which such foul odors exhale, infecting everyone nearby." These hearts breathe nothing of the balm of Heavenly Sophia. The bodies of the pious are fragrant temples of the Spirit of holy WISDOM, imparting good; those of the impious are sepulchers of corpses. No dead body is so devoid of soul as a dead soul forsaken by GOD, whose signature, alas, is such a great stench. No physical corpse so offends the nostrils of men as the stench of a soul buried for four days offends the divine nostrils of all the heavenly beings, that is, the good Spirits. The tongue would speak the living words of GOD if life, GOD, were present there.

Strive, with the divinely granted strength you have, to Theosophically reduce the Ternary, by rejecting the Binary, through the Quaternary, as in the second figure of this Amphitheater, to the simplicity of the Monad, in the name of WISDOM manifested in the flesh, that is, JESUS CHRIST crucified. In this way, your body, spirit, and soul (your whole being) will be gathered together in the name of JESUS. Then, meditate on WISDOM through Christian fasting in prayer. Religiously practice soliloquies in spirit and truth. Surely, HHOCHMA-EL (which in Hebrew means the WISDOM of GOD) will be involved in your thoughts, prayers, soliloquies, and meditations. He will create and preserve the world in your heart. He will renew a right spirit within you. He will find holy, wise, and skillful thoughts within you. He will fill you with the spirit of prudence (Exodus 28:3), and, Divinely inspiring you, will instruct and lead you into the truth of the Awareness, Knowledge, Kinship, Union, and Fruition (as the inscription of this work has it) of JEHOVAH, CREATION, and NATURE, and also of YOURSELF. You will be to the best GOD what his hand is to a good man: it pleases me to be to GOD what GOD commands me to be.

SUMMARY: Theosophically (Believe, Live, Pray, and Labor), you will certainly, as others have, experience what I have said. But whoever wavers in faith should not expect to receive anything from GOD, as James attests in his first canonical epistle, chapter 1, verses 6 and 7. Just as there is no point in arguing with one who denies the Principles except about the Principles, so too there is no need to pray and labor for anything other than true Faith for one who lacks it. That is, Faith (which is the Gift of GOD) should be divinely inspired within him, arise, increase, and be preserved within him. Once you have this, you will Theosophically obtain from GOD everything necessary and useful, and both your prayer and labor will prosperously succeed.

74 INTERPRETATIONS

of things, Eternal and Infernal; the most profound, most abstruse, most hidden, inscrutable and ineffable **CAUSE**, Origin, Seat, Fountain, and Recess, producing wonderful effects, and comprehensible by no sharpness of human reason. There is, moreover, the Abyss of Creation, of which Moses speaks in Genesis 1:2: *And darkness was upon the face of the deep* <note>original: "Abyſſi" — often translated as "the deep" or "the abyss"</note>. There is the Abyss of Holy Scripture, of which Ezekiel speaks in chapter 47, and Ecclesiasticus <note>Also known as the Wisdom of Sirach</note> in 1:2 and 24:8. There is the Abyss of Providence, of which the whole of Psalm 139 speaks. There is the Abyss of Omnipotence and Divine Wisdom, of which Isaiah speaks in chapter 40. There is the Abyss of predestination, of which Saint Paul speaks in Ephesians 1:4 and Romans 9. There is the Abyss of Love, Redemption, and the merit of Christ, of which John 3 and Romans 5 speak. There is the Abyss of the judgments of GOD, of which Psalm 36:6 says: *thy judgments are a great deep* <note>original: "iudicia tua abyſſus multa"</note>; and Ecclesiasticus 38: *His counsels are in the deep.* There is the abyss of human misery and sin, and of the depraved heart, Jeremiah 17:9 and Ezekiel 26:19. There is the abyss of hell, Revelation 9:1 and 2. There is, finally, the abyss of life and eternal joy, where all things lack end and limit, Ezekiel 31:4: *The deep set him up on high*, that is, infinite blessedness and prosperity.

From these, as far as the present purpose is concerned, we shall explain only the Abyss of Creation and of Providence. The Abyss of Creation and of Natural things consists of the Fountains, Origins, Treasures, and invisible Springs—most pure, perpetual, and most hidden—in the Centers of the purest and simplest Elements: namely, of Earth, Water, Air, and the Firmament. In these most hidden treasures, the **seminal reasons** <note>original: "ſeminariæ rerum Rationes" — a philosophical concept referring to the latent "blueprints" or "seeds" implanted by God in nature that determine how things grow and develop</note> of things, which preserve the species, are kept perpetually until the Dissolution of the World. These include the forms, proportions, and habits of Animals, Vegetables, Minerals, rivers, winds, storms, fair weather, times, ages, and of all things, by which they come forth onto this visible stage of the World at appointed times, to administer the Commonwealth of all human life and the course, ebb, and flow of all Nature. This natural Abyss is called by Orpheus "Night," "Darkness," "Mist," and "Inconspicuous Diana," seen by no mortal (that is, seen naked), in the hymn which begins thus: *Night, the origin of all things* <note>original Greek: "Νύξ γένεσις πάντων"</note>. The Abyss of Providence is the most abstruse order of Divine Counsels: the administrator of all Nature and human life, which is the author, moderator, and dispenser of times, ages, changes, years, months, days, hours, and minutes; of Natural things and human actions, duties, vocations, studies, dangers, calamities, afflictions, Deliverances, and of Human Life and Death. The Abyss of Wisdom is delineated in the Book of Wisdom, chapter 7.

*Honey]* Athenaeus writes that Democritus, when he was ill, lived for several days on honey alone, and when he lacked it, he died. Diogenes Laërtius writes that he extended his life for three days when near death by the smell of warm bread. The honeyed doctrine of **Eternal WISDOM** (which is the bread of life, John 6:35), if piously eaten by the pure and clean mouth of the heart, will not only refresh you when you are lying lethally ill with the disease of sin, but will also preserve you from eternal death. For just as little bees make honey from dew and flowers, so the honey of Divine Wisdom is prepared from the **Heavenly, Spiritual, and Divine Dew**—namely, the **HOLY SPIRIT**—and from the flower of your mind—that is, faith, love, hope, and prayer. Even the smallest taste of this honey, perceived by a pious and faithful soul, surpasses all the sweetness, delight, and pleasure of the whole world. Hence the **Psalmist says, "Your words are sweeter to me than honey and the honeycomb"** (Psalm 19:11 and 119:103). May Your sweetness, O LORD, make all the beloved things of the world sweet to me also. In this most sweet honey lies hidden the **SALT OF WISDOM** <note>original: "SAL SAPIENTIÆ" — a term often used in alchemy and theology to describe the preservation of true knowledge</note>, so named wisely by the wise. It is surely a wonderful proof of Divine Goodness that this phrase has remained alive even to our age, even among those practicing profane philosophy; though those wretched little men (by GOD!) have not understood what they were saying. There is a secret power in this speech. Learn, my son.

**The LORD gives, etc.**] Hence Saint James in his Epistle, chapter 1, verse 5 says: *If any of you lacks **WISDOM**, let him ask of **GOD**, who gives to all generously and without reproach (upbraiding), and it will be given to him. **To anticipate the Sun**] To go before the Sun; not only the visible eye (according to **Hermes** <note>Refers to Hermes Trismegistus, the legendary Hellenistic figure associated with hermetic philosophy</note>), that is, the greater light in the Firmament, but also the **DIVINE** eye: and to go out to meet, to encounter, to approach, and to join with You, **JEHOVAH**, at the rising of His light within us, through supplications (1 Timothy 2:1), prayers, petitions: and thanksgivings (since thanksgiving is an invitation to be given more) so that the rays of Your blessing may benignly flow into our minds as well as our actions or labors, at the opportune place and time, to anticipate You: or, to consult You **Theosophically** <note>meaning to seek knowledge of God through direct spiritual insight</note> on all business, and to act with You. Hence Proverbs 20:11 <note>The OCR says 19, 11, but the quote matches 20:11</note>: *Even a child is known by his pursuits, whether his work is pure and right.* **NOTE**: Just as Manna, the food of the Jewish people in the desert, had to be gathered before the rising of the Sun, lest it melt and flow away when struck by the Sun's rays: so must the Manna of Divine Wisdom be gathered in the vessels of morning prayers: and, one must watch early at the doors of **WISDOM**. Let our Sun, which is within us, anticipate the <term>Macrocosmic Sun</term> <note>The physical sun in the outer universe</note>: and let it rise sooner in the <term>Microcosmic</term> <note>The internal "little world" of the human soul</note> inner Heaven than in the external Macrocosm. For the ethereal guardians, who are the vehicles of Light and Wisdom, are present at once to drive away the interior darkness. The Song of Songs describes the Sun rising in us: *I sleep, but my heart is awake* (Song of Solomon 5:2). Not without merit is Manna called the "bread of Angels" in Psalm 78:25. Since Manna was generated supernaturally through Divine Wisdom, it is the fruit of Divine Wisdom. Therefore Wisdom, which proceeds from the mouth of **GOD**, is the true bread of Angels, upon which they are sweetly nourished. And because Jesus Christ is the Word of the Father and the Wisdom of the Father: therefore He is the true Manna of believing Christians. This must be received with a constant heart and an ever-watchful mind; before our mind is shaken by afflictions and dissolved by the cares which each of our days carries with it. **At the rising of the Light**] that is, at the very break of day, in the morning twilight (for *he who seeks good things rises well at dawn*, Proverbs 11:27), at the rising of the Sun, in the dawn, which is pleasing to the Muses and is a truly golden hour—not only of the natural day, but also of your age, of pious devotion, of good mental concepts, etc. immediately, when such a thing rises in you (which rising is called "Dawn" in the school of the <term>Cabalists</term> <note>Practitioners of Kabbalah, a form of Jewish mysticism influential in Renaissance theosophy</note>), when by the impulse of the good Spirit you feel a good motion in you, while the heart is inflamed, dilated, and kindled to perfect such a work; then enter the Oratory <note>a place of prayer</note> both microcosmicly and macrocosmicly, and Pray, meditate, and practice Christian **Theosophical** soliloquies: (know that now Time, Place, Heaven, the Stars, your Genius <note>a personal guardian spirit</note>, the warfare of the Heavenly host, **GOD**—that is, **EVERYTHING**—favors and serves you:) hear, see, and observe, according to the Laws and Doctrine of this **Amphitheater** <note>Likely referring to the author's work, *The Amphitheater of Eternal Wisdom*</note>, whatever **JEHOVAH** suggests and answers to you in **YOURSELF**, in **NATURE**, and in the **HOLY SCRIPTURE**. Enter also the Laboratory, and according to the aforementioned Divine <term>Cabalistic</term> (that is, "Receptive") instruction, used by the truly Wise of old, Labor Wisely: thus **GOD** will give without delay.

Guard, therefore, your thoughts, and let your lips preserve Discipline: let not your tongue run before your mind, according to the advice of Chilon <note>One of the Seven Sages of Greece</note>, who said: "Let not your tongue outrun your mind" <note>original Greek: ἡ γλῶσσά σου μὴ προτρεχέτω τῷ νῷ</note>. The tongue is like a fan of sedition: therefore it must be restrained by everyone as diligently as possible. Hence Zeno <note>The Stoic philosopher</note> ordered one to speak only after the tongue has been dipped in the mind. Always think: where is the tongue going? Be swift to hear, slow and cautious to speak.

84 INTERPRETATIONES

**So the heart of the King, etc.** <note>Referring to Proverbs 21:1: "The king's heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will."</note> Daily experience bears witness that GOD promotes and annihilates the thoughts, actions, and labors of men according to His own pleasure. Therefore, that saying is true:
->*Divine power plays within the affairs of men.*<-
<note>original: "Ludit in humanis Diuina potentia rebus." This is a variation of a line from Ovid, expressing that human life is subject to the unpredictable changes of a higher power.</note>
JEHOVAH inspires both blessing and cursing, both into the work and the man, to whom and when He wills. HE HIMSELF appoints Kings and deposes them; He exalts, humbles, builds up, and destroys; He blesses and He curses; ALL THINGS are in His omnipotent hand. If, therefore, you have business to conduct before Princely persons, tending toward the honor of GOD, the benefit of your Neighbor, or yourself, **Pray and Work** <note>original: "Ora atque Labora"</note> in a **theosophic** manner <term>theosophically</term> (acting through divine wisdom rather than merely human intellect), so that you may be in the Love of GOD. (O, this DIVINE ART OF DIVINE LOVE, which this Amphitheater of ours <note>The author refers to his book, "The Amphitheater of Eternal Wisdom."</note> teaches!) Be a friend of GOD; then the Prince will also be a friend (if what you seek is pleasing to GOD)—merciful, gracious, and kind. For the LORD will turn them wherever He wishes. One must always add: *Lord, your will be done.*

The history of Alexander the Great is well known: when he was besieging Tyre and marching with his army toward Jerusalem because they had denied him supplies, Jaddus the High Priest turned his mind by coming out to meet him in his priestly robes. One reads the same regarding Attila the Hun when he was seeking to attack Rome <note>referring to Pope Leo I persuading Attila to turn back</note>. Ahasuerus was turned by Esther so that he would not destroy the Jews in a single day. See then, learn, and judge: just as the Wise man rules the stars, can he not also rule the souls and minds of men? Even an angry GOD is turned by a praying voice; why not a man? But how, by what art, by what industry, by what **Ray**? <term>Ray</term> (In this context, a "ray" is a direct spiritual influence or emanation from the divine source). By the Ray of Divine Wisdom. 

Do not be so simple-minded as to think it happened without art and without singular Divine Wisdom that Laban heard that voice in his dreams: *Take care that you do not speak to Jacob otherwise than kindly.* Or do you think it happened by chance that Alexander the Great saw the High Priest in his dreams, coming toward him in his vestments? Prick up your ears and inquire into this Wisdom. For if Christians have received power from GOD over all the strength of our most bitter enemy, the devil; why not over the minds of men, who are ruled by the devil?

### THE FOURTH DEGREE. 85

...placed in the Light before the face of GOD and made manifest. For even if our actions, when held up to the Light of human reason, may seem good, lawful, and just; nevertheless, when brought near to the Light of Divine Wisdom, they appear most inept, false, and unjust.

*The lots are cast into the lap, etc.]* If lots are cast concerning secret, abstruse, or hidden things—matters concealed from us, doubtful and mysterious, yet meanwhile useful, beneficial, and (in times of great distress and necessity) absolutely necessary—then they are far from being illicit or prohibited by Holy Scripture. Rather, they are even governed by the LORD; that is, they are directed by Divine Providence and are true Divine responses. We have almost innumerable and very clear commands, testimonies, and examples of this matter expressed in the volume of the Holy Scriptures. These are the testimonies: Isaiah 34:17. HE (the LORD) *cast the lot for it (in dividing the land of Canaan among the Israelite people), and His hand divided it for them by measure.* And, in Proverbs 18, verse 18, the Wise Man says: *The lot suppresses disputes, and decides even between the powerful.* Rightly, therefore, does that Divine Prophet entrust his lots to the Lord, saying: *In your hands, O LORD, are my lots,* <note>original: "In manibus tuis, DOMINE, sortes meae." Referring to Psalm 31:16 in the Latin Vulgate. In most modern English Bibles, this is Psalm 31:15: "My times are in thy hand." Khunrath emphasizes the word 'lots' (sortes) to support his argument for divination by lot.</note> Psalm 31:16. Many examples are found everywhere in sacred history: Aaron, the brother of Moses, is commanded by GOD to cast lots over two goats before the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of the witness—one for the LORD, and the other as a scapegoat; the one whose lot comes out for the LORD, he shall offer for sin; etc. Leviticus 16:8. When Israel had transgressed the covenant of GOD and had taken from the "accursed thing" <note>The "anathema" or devoted things taken from Jericho by Achan.</note>, so that they were struck down by their enemies, the men of the city of Ai, and forced to turn their backs: Joshua searched out the sin of the accursed thing by lot; first investigating by tribe, then from the tribe the clan, from the clan the household, and from the household the man or the very author of the accursed thing, Joshua 7, verse 14 and following. When the Prophet Samuel was occupied in choosing and designating a King for the Israelites by lot, he brought forward all the tribes of Israel, and the lot fell upon the Tribe of Benjamin; and he brought forward the Tribe of Benjamin and its clans, and it fell upon the clan of Matri, and it reached all the way to Saul the son of Kish. 1 Samuel 10:20. And a little later in verse 24, Samuel says to all the people: *Surely you see whom the LORD has chosen (BY LOT), for there is none like him among all the people.* You may read for yourself in 1 Chronicles 24 how the Royal Prophet David divided the Levites by lots (according to how they should enter the house of the Lord for their ministries). Likewise, Jonah was discovered by lot to be the cause of so great a storm that even the ship was in danger. Jonah 1, verse 7. The lot cast into the urn before Haman revealed that in the twelfth month, which is called Adar, the nation of the Jews ought to be killed. Esther 3:7. And truly, unless the Jews—clothed in sackcloth, sprinkling ashes on their heads, crying out to GOD with a loud voice, and praying to him ardently, performing penance with fasting, wailing, and weeping (as is found in chapter 4, verses 1 and 2)—had obtained grace and mercy from GOD; without any doubt, the sentence (concerning the killing of the Jews) of the lot (which is the interpreter of the Divine Will) would never have been changed or retracted.

86 INTERPRETATIONS

If you also wish to look at examples from the New Testament: Was it not by lot that Matthias was chosen for the place of ministry and Apostleship (from which Judas fell away to go to his own place)? Acts 1, last verse. Looking toward this end, GOD commanded the land of Canaan to be distributed to the Israelites by lot. For so He says in Numbers 26, verse 56: *Whatever shall happen by lot, let this be received by either the many or the few.* And in chapter 33, verse 54: *You shall divide the land (which I gave you for a possession) among yourselves by lot: to the many you shall give a wider portion, and to the few a narrower one; to each, as the lot shall fall, so shall the inheritance be granted, the possession shall be divided by tribes and families.* 

And this ritual of casting lots was always in use. For so the Romans once chose their Dictators, Consuls, Senators, and Tribunes of the people through the drawing of lots. So even today in most places and almost everywhere, offices in any station, gifts, inheritances, etc., are distributed by lots. Whence it is said in Ecclesiasticus 14:15: *Will you not leave your sorrows and labors to others in the division of the lot?* But let it suffice to have said these things. For to bring forward everything here which serves to confirm and establish this divine art of divining—divine Geomancy <term>Geomancy: A method of divination that interprets markings on the ground or the patterns formed by tossed handfuls of soil, rocks, or sand. Here, the author views it as a legitimate way to discern God's will.</term>—is not our purpose. From these things, therefore, which have now been said by us, it emerges clearer than the midday light that the Moderator, Ruler, Author, Favorer, Defender, and Promoter of lots is GOD himself.

FOURTH STEP. 87

...established and completed. In the Oratory <note>original: "Oratorio"; the private chapel or place of prayer for an alchemist</note>, therefore, one must sweat **Theosophically**, so that GOD may inform us; that He might not take His Holy Spirit from us; that He might bless us and our labors; and that He might guard our mind, senses, and reason, lest they be seduced by diabolical mockeries and fantasies; and our hands and feet, lest they destroy the work. Cicero, a prudent Heathen, was frustrated in many of his plans and reasons; indeed, he paid the heaviest penalties for his confidence in his own wisdom and industry. What he achieved with worldly prudence is testified by the many sad and tragic voices written back from his exile, which are found in the letters of the third book to Atticus, and in his last letter to Octavius. Therefore, he exclaims as he is being killed, "O, I was never Wise!" Rightly, therefore, does Psalm 33:17 say: *A horse is a vain hope for safety.* And Psalm 127: *Unless the LORD guards the city, etc.* Ecclesiastes 11:5: *As you do not know the path of the Spirit, or how the bones are joined in the womb of a pregnant woman, so you do not know the works of GOD, who is the maker of all.* Therefore, let not our reason or the rashness of our intellect claim such prudence for itself—as if, comparing itself only to itself, it thinks it can govern its life, actions, and labors without a singular and specific Divine Blessing—or think that it can manufacture its own fortune and success, or that it is within its own will and power to achieve anything good. Rather, let him place and establish ALL things in a Christian manner in the hand of the Almighty and Merciful GOD, and let him have his confidence in the LORD (as the Wise Man wisely advises) with his whole heart, from the beginning to the end of his ways—that is, in all his actions and labors, in the **Oratory** and the **Laboratory**. If the Theosophist <note>A seeker of divine wisdom, particularly one who combines spiritual insight with natural philosophy</note> must not fail in this, how much less the sophist <note>Here used disparagingly for those who rely on false reasoning or empty chemical theories</note> in his Labyrinth. The will of JEHOVAH is a surer guide than Ariadne’s thread <note>In Greek mythology, the thread given to Theseus to navigate the Minotaur's labyrinth; the author uses it as a metaphor for divine guidance through the world's confusion</note> for us as we tremble in the great labyrinth of this world.

Comply therefore, you student of Cabala, Magic, and Alchemy, and examine yourself against this Lydian stone <note>A touchstone used to test the purity of gold; here, a metaphor for a spiritual test</note>: if your trust is in the LORD, you will draw the salvation of His will from the LORD, and all things will succeed prosperously for you; you will be three and four times happy in both practice and theory; nor will you be confounded forever (as Experience itself testifies along with Holy Scripture). Hence 2 Maccabees 8:36: Nicanor preached that the Jews had GOD as a protector, and because of Him they were INVULNERABLE, because they followed the Laws established by Him. This same thing is meant by the following verse, written on an old tapestry in a certain French castle, in which a woman was depicted spinning thread; King Francis of France often debated its meaning:

*God joins the mind of the spinner to Olympus.* <note>original: "Nenti fila DEVS mentem coniungit Olympo." Olympus here represents Heaven.</note>

That is, GOD assists the labor of the calling; <gloss>He joins the thread for the spinner.</gloss> And that help, which He commands us to seek from Him while we work, joins the mind to Olympus; <gloss>He bids us go up toward Heaven in thought and prayer.</gloss> Not in vain have I brought forward the passage from Hermes <note>Hermes Trismegistus, the legendary founder of alchemy</note>, verse 317: *He who did not spare his own soul, etc.* There lies hidden the secret of **CONJUNCTION** and **UNION** in his universal Physico-Chemical Stone <note>The Philosopher's Stone, viewed here as both a physical substance and a divine mystery</note>, concerning which it is not at all advisable to speak more openly. See verse 132.

GOD speaks to many, yet they neither understand nor observe Him speaking or answering; indeed (alas!) being warned by perverse teachers and seduced by their own malice, they are unwilling to observe and understand **Theosophically** <note>meaning "through divine wisdom," a method of looking for God's presence in all things</note> and they reject it. These are specifically: **KABBALAH** (not that literal, common kind used by the Jews, such as <term>Notaricon</term> <note>shorthand or acronyms</note>, <term>Gematria</term> <note>calculating the numerical value of words</note>, or <term>Temurah</term> <note>the permutation of letters</note>—see verse 5—which is inferior; but that more recondite and far superior kind, known to the Lovers of Divine Wisdom only by Divine Influence, Light, and Motion); **MAGIC**; and its relatives, **PHYSIOGNOMY** <note>judging character from the face</note>, **METOPOSCOPY** <note>judging character from the lines of the forehead</note>, **CHIROMANCY** <note>palm reading</note>, and the entire Doctrine of the Natural **SIGNATURES** of Things; **ALCHEMY**; **ASTROLOGY** also with her daughter **GEOMANCY** <note>divination by means of lines or patterns on the earth</note>, and several **OTHERS**, which wonderfully and as if miraculously tell of and serve their marvelous **MISTRESS**. 

Yet beware, I pray you, my brother, that you do not falsely attribute to the Sciences and Arts themselves—which in themselves are not impure—the lies of the prince of this world, nor the vices or errors of "pseudo-craftsmen." These errors willingly prostitute themselves as **TRUTH** (as a just and worthy punishment) to worldly seekers of **TRUTH** who have not yet been washed and purged in the manner of Divine Wisdom—that is, to little fools—by the command and will of true **WISDOM**. For thus, virtue has often borne the blame for vice. It is truly said that sacred things are profaned because they are used profanely by profane people. Even a good thing, when turned to abuse, becomes an evil. But *to the pure all things are pure*, Titus 1:15; Romans 14:20. *And we know that all things work together for good to them that love GOD*, Romans 8:28, verse 261. All things are good and evil,

...in respect and use they are diverse. Let someone name for me, I pray, any single science or Art in the whole nature of things that does not have its own abuse as well as its legitimate and upright use. And by what privilege, I beseech you, should the aforementioned [sciences] be exempt? Therefore let Justice be done; let to each what is his own be given, and let no one be harmed. **GOD** reforms man who has been defiled by sin; so too must the defiled secret Sciences and Arts be reformed. **THESE THEMSELVES**, as **Theosophical Means** <note>Tools for attaining Divine Wisdom</note>, are to be retained, and they are to be used wisely in the Fear of **GOD**; the sophistical and impious things are to be rejected. <note>original German: "Man muß das beſudelte kindt waſchen/ vnd nicht mit dem vnreinen bade hinweg ſchütten."</note> One must wash the soiled child and not throw it out with the dirty bathwater. Nor to you, Slanderer—if there is something you do not know, it is not therefore denied to the rest of us to know it. I know that wagonloads of objections can be brought forward from the sacred scriptures, from canon and civil law, and from the Church fathers; but by making a distinction between true and legitimate use and abuse, we shall sufficiently respond to all the objections of absolutely every babbler. To the wretched ignorant ones, sin is to be forgiven, and repentance is to be hoped for. See verses 157, 187, and 294.

***So that they might call, etc.***] So that they might lead; so that through their mediation, the faithful and beloved lovers of **Theosophy** <note>Divine Wisdom</note> might arrive at the Recognition, Knowledge, Union, and Enjoyment of their **DIVINE LADY**, and might become partakers of the inexhaustible treasures of **WISDOM**. *Through the ways of Prudence*] The ways of PRUDENCE and UNDERSTANDING, that is, the Degrees of KNOWLEDGE and the LADDER of UNION with GOD. Through these ways, the WISDOM of JEHOVAH—whose delights are to be with the children of men <note>A reference to Proverbs 8:31, "and my delights were with the sons of men," signifying God’s desire for relationship with humanity.</note>—descends by the mercy of His kind will. These ways, I say, may be seen in the second figure of this Amphitheater <note>The author refers to the "Amphitheatrum Sapientiae Aeternae" (Amphitheater of Eternal Wisdom), the famous illustrated work by Heinrich Khunrath from which this text likely originates.</note>.

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*He shall draw grace, etc.]* Just as the Grace of GOD makes men good, so does it cherish and adorn with many gifts of grace those who are the dwellings of piety and divine fear. For there are various degrees of these Gifts. Just as solar rays illuminate a dark glass obscurely, but if the glass is a little clearer, they illuminate it more; and if it is very clear and transparent, they illuminate it most brightly; so too is the human soul. If it is in some way purified, it is indeed illuminated by the ray of eternal Wisdom, but somewhat obscurely. If it is more thoroughly cleansed of its vices, it is more clearly illuminated; and if it is most pure—having almost forgotten all earthly things—it is most brightly illuminated by a certain inward vision of GOD. This is as the Savior testifies in Matthew 5, verse 8: *Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see GOD.* And in Hebrews 12:14: *Follow holiness, without which no one shall see GOD.* 

What, however, is this vision? It is the knowledge of Divine mysteries, which the Psalmist calls the hidden Wisdom of GOD <note>original: "occultam DEI Sapientiam"</note>, Psalm 51:8 <note>In modern Bibles, this is usually Psalm 51:6: "thou shalt make me to know wisdom."</note>. No man of evil thoughts shall draw this from GOD; instead, he shall be filled with inner and outer darkness, which is the true condemnation.

->FOURTH STEP. 95<-

*They do not understand judgment* <note>original: "Non intelligunt iudicium"</note>] Many things happen in common life which are truly the judgments of the LORD: yet the impious do not understand these, but think they happen by some chance, not noticing the admirable Prudence of GOD. However, those who are endowed with the Spirit of Divine Wisdom can judge even those things which portend either the safety or the ruin of men; indeed, they judge all human actions entirely, discerning what outcome or end they shall have. *The judgments of GOD are a great deep.* <note>original: "Iudicia DEI abyssus multa." A reference to Psalm 36:6, suggesting that God's decisions are profound and beyond easy human comprehension.</note> *But those seeking JEHOVAH, etc.*] Great (alas!) is the darkness of human reason, which without Divine Revelations can perceive the reason, cause, and end of no work of GOD. By what means, truly, and by what path such revelations are to be reached, our Wise man clearly teaches with a golden axiom: THOSE SEEKING THE LORD SHALL UNDERSTAND ALL THINGS. <note>original: "QVÆRENTES DOMINVM, INTELLIGENT OMNIA"</note> The Patriarch Joseph, the Prophet Daniel, and many others serve as examples. Memorable is that passage from Job chapter 32, verses 7 and 8: *I hoped that a longer age would speak, and a multitude of years would teach Wisdom. But as I see, there is a Spirit in men, and the Inspiration of the Almighty gives Understanding.*

| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 196 Blessings are upon the head of the righteous: but the mouth of the impious covers iniquity. | Prov. 10 Verse 6. | [pointing hand symbol] The *Blessing* of the LORD is 196 *upon the head of the righteous: but iniquity covers the mouth of the impious:* |

*The Blessing of the LORD, etc.*] Formerly, Kings, High Priests, and beloved guests were anointed with Balsam, and hands were also placed upon the head to be blessed: in the same way, Divine Wisdom anoints its worshippers with the Balsam of the Spirit, adorns its guests with gifts, and places its saving hands upon the head of the righteous. For just as the head is the ornament and glory of a man, so Divine WISDOM (which is the most majestic crown of the head) adds by far the most beautiful ornament to a man. Stand, therefore, at the throne of WISDOM with bowed knees, and incessantly and constantly entreat for Spiritual Blessing with a humble mouth and mind: and the blessing shall descend upon your head like dripping Balsam. But the mouth of the impious, which foams with nothing but arrogance, pride, insults, and uncleanness, shall be covered by confusion.

*Scoffer* <note>original: "Illusor"</note>] One who is perverse in heart and double-tongued, turning away from GOD and casting off the Fear of GOD. For this reason, some have translated it: *JEHOVAH abominates the deserter*, that is, one who, having turned away from the height of Divine contemplations and actions, sinks toward the slopes of this unclean world, no matter how much the good Spirit of WISDOM had raised him on high. *With the simple*] With the upright, the whole, the uncontaminated, and the honest, who have nothing feigned or disguised...

To those who possess [wisdom], the Wise man says, **JEHOVAH** speaks Theo-Sophically <note>original: "Theo-Sophicè"; meaning through Divine Wisdom</note>, through His **WORD** as found in the Bible, and as written Divinely in the Macro-cosm and Micro-cosm <note>original: "Macro & Micro-Cosmicè"; the macrocosm refers to the universe, and the microcosm refers to the human being as a reflection of that universe</note>. Even in the **Oratory** and the **Laboratory** <note>original: "Oratorio & Laboratorio"; the dual space of the alchemist-philosopher intended for both prayer and scientific work</note>, He reveals and communicates His mysteries and secrets through <term>Cabala</term> <note>a mystical method of interpreting scripture</note>, <term>Physico-Magic</term>, and <term>Physico-Chemistry</term>. Hence the Philosopher says: *If GOD were to find a faithful heart, He would surely reveal the truth of His secrets to it.* Happy is the one who has **JEHOVAH** as a counselor in this way. Consult the fourth figure of this *Amphitheater*. *His speech*] Oh, the wonderful discourse of the wonderful **GOD**! The voice of **GOD** is in all things, through all things, concerning all things, and to all people. **GOD** speaks with us always and everywhere. It has pleased **GOD** to speak Biblically, and through the Macro-cosm and Micro-cosm: it is our duty—as we are formed in the image and likeness of **GOD**—to hear, see, observe **JEHOVAH** (so that He does not "sing to the deaf" <note>original: "ne surdo canat"; a Latin idiom meaning to speak to someone who will not listen</note>) as He sounds, thunders, speaks, and responds in the Holy Scriptures, in Nature, and within Our-selves, as is noted in the fourth figure of this *Amphitheater*. See verses 35, 37, and 342.

*He will mock the mockers*] Truly, He renders those ridiculous jesters absurd themselves, returning "like for like" <note>original: "Lege talionis"; the law of retaliation</note> to them. They mock **WISDOM**; in turn, they are mocked by **HER**. This is the most just law of **WISDOM** incarnate: *With the same measure you use, it will be measured back to you.* With the holy, **JEHOVAH** is holy, and with the blameless man, He is innocent; with the chosen, He is chosen; and with the perverse, He is perverse, as it says in Psalm 18:25. *To the meek*] To the humble: for these He exalts, while the proud He casts down. Humility or meekness—the casting down of oneself in the Fear of **GOD** (before **GOD**) —is the glorious finding, exaltation, and sublimation of oneself in **GOD** through the fruits of **WISDOM**. For **GOD** exalts the humble in heart and renders them sublime. See verse 202. <margin>184</margin>

**He who is of a perverse heart]** To a perverse heart is also joined a perverse tongue, which opens up the "treasure" of the heart <note>The author suggests that the words we speak reveal the hidden contents of our inner character</note> and prepares a pit of destruction for itself. For the tongue of the perverse person is the architect of their own ruin; thus the impious man perishes by his own tongue. And from this come those "learned perverts" <note>original Latin: "eruditi illi peruersi"</note>, about whom the proverb was born: *the learned, the perverted* <note>original German: "die gelehrten/ die verferten/"; a play on words suggesting that high worldly learning often leads to moral or spiritual deviation</note>. See verses 187, 294.

**WISDOM** is not sold for money; nor does it pass as an inheritance to children: by prayers from the whole heart poured out to **JEHOVAH**, it behooves us to seek and obtain it from the Benevolence of the Benevolent <note>The author uses a play on words: "from the Kindness of the Kind One," emphasizing that God gives freely to those who ask</note> (that He may Benevolently send it). **THE SUM:** In Spirit and Truth one must Pray for Her: and for Her treasures to be successfully obtained, one must wisely **Labor**. The **ORATORY** <term>Oratorium</term> <note>A place dedicated to prayer and spiritual meditation</note> therefore and **LABORATORY** <term>Laboratorium</term> <note>A place for physical experiment and work, specifically in the context of alchemy or chemistry</note>, according to the Laws and Doctrine of this **Amphitheater** <note>Referring to the author's work, the "Amphitheater of Eternal Wisdom"</note>, must be entered wisely. See verse 87. Note: a fool in this place can also be understood as one who is "profanely learned": possessing riches and gifts of genius, but without the **Fear of GOD**: *A language-learned fool / A foolish linguist* <note>original German: "Ein Sprach-gelehrter Narr / Ein närrischer Sprachgelehrter"</note>; a lettered fool, not a learned one <note>original Latin: "literatus stultus, non doctus"</note>.

**Where there has been pride, etc.]** **JEHOVAH** abominates the proud; for the proud resist the Divine majesty; therefore **GOD** also resists the proud, 1 Peter 5:5. Because only the humble depend on Divine Grace: therefore to the humble **GOD** gives grace. Because the proud affect the throne of **GOD**, therefore **GOD** punishes them either by the error of their plans or by the unhappiness of their outcomes, so that all their plans and outcomes are turned into their own disgrace, confusion, and ruin. On the contrary, however, he adorns the humble with Light, and the Gift of the Spirit of Understanding, of counsel, of fortitude, of strength, and of knowledge—which gifts are the sources of happy success in governance and human actions. **Abomination of the LORD, etc.]** **GOD** wants us to know and confess with mouth and heart that the Goods and Gifts we enjoy in all our life are **GOD'S**: nor should we ascribe anything to our own prudence or strengths. *Not to us, Lord, not to us; but to your Name give glory.* Psalm 115:1. *Better is the patient man than the arrogant.* Ecclesiastes 7:9.

...differing and toiling: because they are fools. Do not say to them, "Greetings" <note>original: *ave*</note>; let them not even be your acquaintances. A neighbor contracts the plague from a neighbor.
*Trust in God faithfully; trust a mortal cautiously;*
*And look well beforehand, whether he is worthy of trust.*
For to trust much, and to have seen little, prepares the greatest losses. A grape, says Juvenal <note>original: *Uva, inquit Iuvenalis*</note>, catches its blight from a grape seen nearby <note>A reference to Juvenal’s *Satires*, suggesting that vice is contagious among companions</note>. The power of habit or social interaction is great in either direction. One must walk with the few, and those being good. Each person is such as the company in which he delights. For he who is not known by himself is known by his companion. A companion is the shadow of a companion.
However, **WISDOM** conquers malice (Wisdom of Solomon 7, verse 30): therefore, in the **WISDOM** of **GOD** made flesh <note>Referring to Christ as the Incarnate Wisdom</note>, we may be able to report a triumph over malice, if only we have been wise in her, in whom we shall also conquer. Therefore, be One with yourself, but not alone; because you are in the One: Triune in the **TRIUNE**. Incarnate **WISDOM** says, where two or three are gathered in my name, **I AM** in their midst. Male and female are **TWO**: Body, Spirit, and Soul are **THREE** distinct essences, gathered together in the person of the student of *Theo-Sophia* <term>Theo-Sophia</term> <note>Literally "God-Wisdom"; the study of divine mysteries and the inner knowledge of God</note> in the name of IHSVH <note>The "Pentagrammaton," a Kabbalistic rendering of the name of Jesus used in Western Esotericism</note> **CHRIST** crucified, the incarnate **WISDOM** of the Father; they are **ONE**: in the midst of these is He **WHO WAS, WHO IS, WHO SHALL BE, GOD; THE WISDOM OF GOD; THE SPIRIT OF DIVINE WISDOM**. Then you will say more rightly and truly than Scipio did <note>Scipio Africanus the Elder, as quoted by Cicero, famously said he was never less idle than when he was at leisure</note>, that you are never less idle than when at leisure: nor less alone than when alone. And: that while at leisure, you do more. O blessed leisure <note>original: *otium*</note>, by no means lazy! Which the filthy world <note>original: *mundus immundus*</note> does not grasp. Only the friend of **GOD** enjoys this leisure, not the friend of fools, who are wise in a worldly and profane way. A man of shameless brow <note>original: *perfrictae frontis*; an idiom for one who is arrogant or has cast off all shame</note> will not grasp these things.

# THE FIFTH STEP. 101

"Nor with wasting envy," etc. <note>original: *Neque cum inuidia tabeſcente, &c.*</note> I will not communicate; I will have nothing in common; I will not associate with the envious. For it is the custom of Philosophers not to be envious. Therefore, pious antiquity wished the doors of the Muses to be open. Yet not without distinction to everyone: But to whom? Only to the sons of Doctrine and Discipline. For the gifts of GOD are to be shared honestly and generously only with honest and generous minds (lest pearls be cast before swine possessed by the devil, verse 344). The most learned Zwinger <note>Theodor Zwinger (1533–1588), a Swiss physician and philosopher</note> rightly says in his Hippocratic tables, page 37: "This," he says, "was the ancient majesty of the arts: that they were not shared except with the initiated, either by word of mouth—whom they called listeners <note>original: *ἀκροατὰς*</note>, from which the Kabbalah <term>Kabbalah</term> <note>The "received" mystical tradition of the Hebrews</note> takes its name; or in writing, but in an obscure way so that the profane crowd might be kept away, and the secret might be shared only with those who understand (verse 43)." Indeed, the very prostituting of the Arts seems to steal away both their authority and, because of contempt, their efficacy. Those who rashly reveal the secrets of the arts to outsiders are just as worthy of the whip as those who, out of envy, refuse to share even with the initiated. These are his words. The quoted words of our Wise Man, and those in verse 147, should be prudently interpreted according to this sense. You might perhaps object, O clever one, to the envy of those philosophizing in Physico-Chemistry concerning the highest Good in Nature and Art. Hear Rosinus the Philosopher <note>An ancient alchemical authority, likely Zosimos of Panopolis</note>: "It is the judgment of GOD that those who know this matter find envy—not because of the world's greed, but lest the wicked, perceiving this, become more ready to perform profane acts, and the Philosophers be made to give an account for their sins." Behold, you also have in the words of Zwinger already cited a sufficiently honorable, sufficient, just, and fair response.

| | | |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| <margin>208</margin> Wine makes a mocker, strong drink <note>original: *Séchar*</note> makes a brawler: and everyone who delights in it will not be wise. | <column-break/> ->Prou 20<- ->Verse 1.<- <column-break/> | WINE is a luxurious thing, and drunkenness is riotous: whoever is delighted by these will not be wise. <margin>208</margin> |

"WINE is a luxurious thing," etc. Heraclitus said: it is difficult to hide folly; but in wine, it is impossible. Cato: With one exception, no one ever approached the overthrow of the Republic while sober. Plato: In a life that is not sober, no one ever becomes Wise, and much less becomes moderate. Seneca: Vices conceived in wine and hardened by the habit of childhood are powerful even without wine. Wisdom, therefore, is not to be drained from drinking cups. But you will greatly desire that you might be permitted to drink from the silver cup of the Patriarch Joseph, Genesis 44:5, in which he prophesied and foretold the future. Indeed, who will deny that this cup was cast astronomically from Philosophical Electrum <term>Electrum</term> <note>In alchemy, a magical alloy of the seven metals corresponding to the planets</note> by the highest Divine-Magical craftsmanship? There exist things which Aureolus of Hohenheim <note>The famous physician and alchemist Paracelsus</note>, the Master of Mysteries, left to posterity concerning that Electrum. Wisdom offers such a cup to her lovers in the Song of Songs 8:2, and inebriates them with Celestial Nectar. Those Celestial influences and starry treasures, which are the guardians of all natural Wisdom, most willingly flow into and lower themselves into sober souls who thirst for wisdom. But the drunken and mad fools heaven allows to remain unstable and clumsy <note>original: *Die vollen vnd tollen Narren aber leſſet der himmel vnſteter vnd Tölpel bleiben*</note>.

Just as other Psalms are classified as penitential, blessing-giving, cursing-giving, liberating, or vindicating, so this one, I say, is an **Antidote** and a defense against all adversities. The Hebrews observed this; the Christians proved it; you will experience it yourself, if you pray the Psalms of David every day in a "Davidic" manner. But it is a great and rare thing to pray in a Davidic manner! None understand this except those who are well-practiced in the school of the cross and tribulations. *Do not speak anything rashly]* The searcher of hearts loves the address of a pure, inward, and sincere heart, as it is written in Psalm 19:14 <note>The text cites verse 15, following the numbering of the Latin Vulgate</note>: And let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be always pleasing in your sight, O Lord, my helper and my redeemer. For the sighs of the pious proceed from the Holy Spirit, when He groans within us; but words, for the most part, come from human imagination <note>original: "phantasia"</note>: and there is a great difference between the words of the Spirit and the words of the mouth.

238 THE VOW.
Deuteronomy 23.

[Full-width paragraph]
*If you have vowed anything to GOD, etc.]* The Wise Man speaks in the manner of the Old Testament. For the pious, when established in narrow straits <note>i.e., in times of distress or difficulty</note>, were accustomed to promise to GOD sacrifices of thanksgiving <note>original: "χαριστικά" (charistika) - offerings made to express gratitude</note>. Just as Hannah in 1 Samuel 1:11, when she asked GOD for a son, vows and promises that she will return that very son to the Lord: just as Jephthah did in Judges 11:30. Vow and pay to the Lord your GOD, says the Psalmist in Psalm 76:11. And, what has once gone out from your lips, you shall observe, Deuteronomy 23:23. Such vows proceed from the highest love of GOD, a most holy desire, and sincere gratitude of soul: and they must be paid to GOD without hesitation. Thus the Patriarch Jacob, when he had seen the celestial ladder in his sleep, vowing to GOD upon waking, said he would build a House of GOD in that place—that is, that he would propagate the knowledge and true worship of GOD there, and the doctrine of the Messiah. Genesis 28:20. 

We in the New Testament have vowed to GOD a vow of filial obedience in Baptism, and we pay this vow to GOD in holiness and justice, faith, patience, and humility. We therefore define the vow of the New Testament thus: A vow is an obligation to perform the worship of the first table <note>The "First Table" refers to the first few of the Ten Commandments, which concern a person's direct relationship and duties to God</note>, which are: the Fear of GOD, faith, love, patience, invocation, thanksgiving, confession, and the preaching of the Divine Name. These vows must absolutely be paid to GOD by all Christians. Special vows, however, are when—beyond our usual liberality toward the poor—we bind ourselves to some peculiar and singular benefit by which either the honor of GOD or the salvation of men is promoted: and this without any hypocrisy, nor rashly, but from an inward and sincere gratitude of soul for this purpose: that the benefit received from GOD, which we obtained through prayers, may also redound to the benefit of our neighbor.

FIFTH GRADE. 127

*Send her.*] GOD gives and sends WISDOM; no human, nor any (human-made) book does. She is found with GOD, not humans, or any other creature. <note>See verses 167 and 187.</note> She is communicated to us by the Influence, Light, and Motion of the Divine Sun. Therefore, let us all cry out with our whole heart: "Drop down, ye Divine Heavens from above, and let the clouds of the ALL-WISE rain down WISDOM; let the earth of my Mind be opened, and bring forth the new man; who, reformed according to the pattern of the Archetype <note>The original model or ideal form of a human as intended by God</note>, may live forever."

*From your holy Heavens.*] MOSES, the most truthful historian of all Nature—being led and guided by the only TRUTHFUL one, through the influence, light, and motion of the SUN OF TRUTH—says in Genesis 1:1: "In the beginning ELOHIM <note>A Hebrew name for God</note> created the HEAVENS." This, from its own nature and substance, has the proper name in Hebrew *SCHAMAIM*, as if it were *ESCH VA MAIM* <note>original: "ESCH VA MAIM"</note>; FIRE and WATER; a Watery Fire or a Fiery Water. In Greek it is *AITHER* <note>original: "ΑΙΘΗΡ"</note>, as if from the words meaning "I burn" and "spirit"; a BURNING SPIRIT. <note>The author provides several German variations here:</note> A spirit-fiery water; a watery fiery spirit; a fiery spirit-water; ETHERIC LIQUID. This is true regardless of how much Aristotle might chatter to the contrary, foolishly rebuking others to establish his own falsehoods about the eternity of the world. ELOHIM distributed this throughout the entire worldly UNIVERSE in three ways.

First, BELOW, he placed it in the EARTH and WATER, so that it would be for you not only the seat and vehicle of the SOUL of the World, but also the connecting MEDIUM and the uniting BOND joining two extremes: primary MATTER and FORM—that is, *HYLE* <note>The Greek term for "matter"</note> as well as the SOUL OF THE WORLD, NATURE, and the *RUACH ELOHIM* <note>The Spirit of God</note>. This can be seen more extensively in verses 162 and 187, and in the fifth and sixth questions of the third figure of this *Amphitheater*. The entire lower globe is full of *SCHAMAIM*, the Heaven, the Etheric Spirit; for it has penetrated all bodies of the sublunary mass, diffused through and into ALL THINGS by the will of GOD. Nor is anything found (as experience witnesses) in the whole world or the span of the entire Ocean that lacks its spark. It lives here mixed, found and moving with the Elements and their fruits; it is coagulated and frozen, and in some things even fixed. This Giant Fire of Nature, judging each thing, relaxes and resolves it from the bonds of its coagulations and fixations—through the methods of Physical-Chemistry—into a SPIRIT visible and obvious to all the senses. By separating it from the superfluities mixed into it, the fire purifies it and thus restores it to its primordial liberty. GOD not only placed and wisely reserved the Heavens, but also the Earth and Water—that is, the primordial matter <note>original: "hylin", from the Greek 'hyle', meaning raw matter or wood</note> or seeds of this entire world, which exist even today in their universal, original state, animated by a spark of the universal **SOUL OF THE WORLD** <note>original: "ANIMÆ MVNDI scintilla Catholica"</note>; (see Figure 3, Question 7 of this *Amphitheater*). From these, as if in and from a macrocosmic subject that is universally visible <note>original: "synoptico"</note>, one might—through Physico-Chemical preparation and Christian-Cabbalistic handling—universally seek and extract the knowledge of the Creator and of the crucified JESUS CHRIST, whom He sent. I could very easily show from these things sufficient causes for the use of the **DIVINE** Philosopher’s Stone in a Christian-Cabbalistic way (see Figure 4 of this *Amphitheater*, where it treats the **URIM & THUMMIM** <note>Sacred objects used by ancient Hebrew priests for divination, here used as a metaphor for divine revelation in alchemy</note>), if it were permitted to break the Heavenly seal and the seal of hidden revelation, and to divulge the mysteries of GOD. For the present, let it suffice what I have shown: for it befits the God-wise seeker to philosophize not only about the *use* of the Heavens, but also about their Substance, Essence, and Nature. These are the **SUPER-CELESTIAL WATERS** (found by the Wise man in the nature of lower things); they are the purest, most subtle, fiery, most radiant, more than perfect, and therefore incorruptible—permanently fixed within themselves, yet liquid and fluid, flammable but not at all combustible. They exist for this purpose: that in the highest region of all, they might constitute the *Schamaim*, or the Third Heaven; which is watery on its inner surface, but fiery on its outer edge—a blazing fire, a burning water. 

What more? Right here, in these lower things (even if only in the macrocosmic universal view), there exists a Water so noble, or a watery fire so marvelous, of a super-celestial substance and nature, contrary to common style and reason, which is found only by the Wise man through wisdom. How much more, then, in the highest region—that is, above the Firmament, in the world called "Divine" for its use—is it hyperphysical <note>existing beyond physical laws</note>! Far be it from those wise in Physico-Chemistry to think the contrary, let alone to state or speak it.

**I PROCEED:** By the power of the **WORD OF JEHOVAH**, the **HEAVEN** was lifted on high as if by a certain grasping or a screw-mechanism, and the **FIRMAMENT** was established (as has been said). Therefore, the **BINARY** <term>Binary: In this philosophical context, the "Binary" (the number two) represents duality, division, and the fallen state of man separated from the Divine Unity.</term> is to be rejected. See the second figure of this Amphitheatre. **The earthly habitation depresses, etc.**] Our mind, dwelling in a body that is corruptible and mortal because of sin, is held shut away as if in a dark prison, so that man cannot rightly acknowledge **GOD**, nor know Nature and himself from and through himself. For this reason, **GOD** must be prayed to, so that through theosophical exercise in the love of **GOD** (having penitentially conquered and overcome the passions of the flesh), one may be snatched away to the contemplation and handling of Divine, Spiritual, and Natural things. Thus, as if drawn up by God from the depths of the prison and placed at the summit of the dwelling, the mind may begin to see what it could not see before when placed at the bottom. In its own way, it may secretly enjoy the sweetest conversation with **JEHOVAH** and the good spirits delegated by **GOD**; it may be intoxicated with Divine Nectar, and thus reach the knowledge and enjoyment of the whole **UNIVERSE**. (See verse 145). This is understood only by the faithful student of Divine Love.

**Lest perhaps being full, etc.**] The moderate comforts of life are to be desired by the Wise man. The Poet <note>A reference to the Roman poet Ovid, who in *Metamorphoses* 1.140 called wealth the "incitements to evil" (*irritamenta malorum*)</note> calls riches and wealth *stimulants of evil*. Pharaoh, in his greatest wealth and power, imprudently and arrogantly uttered this voice: *Who is JEHOVAH?* Therefore, excessive riches brought him to ruin; for he experienced a higher and more powerful Lord in the Red Sea, whom he—hardened in mind—refused to revere, fear, and acknowledge despite so many supernatural and plainly divine wonders. Therefore, those are mistaken who seek only "mountains of gold" <note>An ancient idiom for immense wealth, often used here to criticize "false" alchemists who seek only material riches rather than spiritual enlightenment</note> in our <term>more secret philosophy</term>; this is the mark of a Fool, not a Wise man. For Wisdom is the worshiper and lover of GOD, not of gold. This <term>Celestial Bride</term> <note>A traditional personification of Divine Wisdom (Sophia)</note> is free from all greed, luxury, pride, and haughtiness; she walks in a simple, humble, yet honorable and clean garment. She uses prosperity modestly and prepares herself to endure adversity. Indeed, so that she may gather the treasure of Divine and Natural Mysteries, she sustains poverty, burdens, and labors, and does not easily yield to hardships:

By the Book of Holy Scripture, the Book of Nature, and the Book of Self, the heart of man is freed from corruption, diabolical filth, and ignorance. <br/>

**Discipline, etc.**] Just as one who neglects medicine hates and despises the health of the body and is an enemy to this physical life: so too he who neglects discipline—which is the medicine of the soul—is an enemy and a murderer of his own soul. And, just as there is "health to the navel and moisture to the bones" for those who fear the Lord and turn away from evil (Proverbs 3:8), so, on the contrary, there is decay, wasting, and the like—the gnawing worm of conscience—for those who despise the Fear of the Lord and discipline (Psalm 32:3). **Possessor of the heart.**] This means he is the master of his own emotions: anger, hatred, joy, sadness, fear, and pleasure. If one learns to rightly rule and moderate these emotions, he will truly act more prudently in all things, and by possessing and moderating his own heart, he shall possess glory and honor.

Indeed, the very hidden property of things and the latent spirit betrays itself by certain external marks and signs, and according to its nature and disposition, it fashions such a <term>signature</term> <note>the theory that the outward appearance of an object or person reveals its inner nature or medicinal use</note>, figure, proportion, and habit as it wishes to be known by the Wise. This Signature is the beginning, and as it were the alphabet and first element, of <term>Natural Magic</term>. Thus, this "painting" is especially to be recognized in the face and habit of man. For the signature of all Nature concurs in the <term>Microcosm</term> <note>Man seen as a "little world" that mirrors the macrocosm of the universe</note>. Here, the characters of Nature and the hieroglyphic marks are certain...

...they produce sense and meaning, which are rightly understood by the Wise and those skilled in this natural writing and literature. Fire, Air, Water, Earth; Vegetables, Animals, Minerals, Metals, all have their own <term>signatures<note>The "Doctrine of Signatures" was the belief that every object in the natural world has a physical sign or "signature" that reveals its inner properties or divine purpose.</note></term>: Angels have their marks: all the Prophets, all the Apostles, and all the Saints: indeed, the Savior himself has the sign of the Son of Man in the shape of the Cross.

II. The natural influence of the stars, and the fruit of the stars—whenever they have reached maturity to show some natural benefit to the world and produce it from their treasures (for all natural wisdom is in the stars)—they incline such a mind from its first conception. From this, various artisans emerge in various things and faculties. Hence the Poet sings:
      *Heavenly genius rises faster than its years,*
            *And poorly bears the losses of ungrateful delay.* <note>A quote from Ovid, suggesting that divinely inspired talent matures much faster than the typical human lifespan.</note>

Here lies hidden the Cabalistic Spirit and the school of the wise <term>Theophrastic philosophy<note>Referring to the mystical and alchemical philosophy of Theophrastus Paracelsus (1493–1541).</note></term>.
