# THE SIXTH GRADE. 145

...as will be clear from what follows. But how? you will ask again. Immediately, I respond, and mediately, according to the most free will of GOD; and indeed: **TheoSophically; Physically; Physico-Medically; Physico-Chemically; Physico-Magically; Hyperphysico-Magically;** and **Cabalistically**; according to the Law and Doctrine of this entire *Amphitheater* <note>The author refers to his book, the *Amphitheatrum Sapientiae Aeternae* (Amphitheater of Eternal Wisdom).</note>. The terms I have listed are few, yet their meaning spreads itself very widely. You seek definitions: rightly so; I provide them.

**THEOSOPHY** <term>Theosophy: Derived from the Greek for "God-wisdom," this refers to a mystical understanding of the divine through direct experience and the study of nature.</term> is Catholic <note>original: *Catholica*; here meaning "universal" or "all-encompassing" rather than the specific denomination.</note> Theology, in the triad (that is, Biblically, and in the Macro & Micro-Cosm), of the wonderful and miracle-working JEHOVAH (verse 157. The Voice of GOD in All things, through All things, concerning All things, to All people. (verse 35).

**PHYSICS** is the knowledge and treatment of both Worlds—that is, of the Greater whole <note>The Macrocosm or the Universe.</note> and the Lesser <note>The Microcosm or the Human Being.</note> (according to the Body and Spirit, which it has from the Macrocosm)—by Tradition, Nature, and Art; Universally, from and in the most holy Scripture, the Philosophers' Stone, and Ourselves; Particularly from and in the parts of men.

**PHYSICO-MEDICINE** is the art of knowing the great Book of Nature (Macro & Micro-Cosmically): so that you may be able to read (both universally and particularly) Yourself in the greater World; and conversely, the greater World in Yourself: for the sake of protecting the health of the human body and driving away diseases (v. 297). 
<margin>To this belongs the **Doctrine of Signatures**. <note>The "Signatura" is the belief that plants or minerals have physical features that "signify" their medicinal use (e.g., a heart-shaped leaf for heart ailments).</note></margin>

**PHYSICO-CHEMISTRY** is the art of dissolving, purifying, and rightly reuniting Physical things chemically, according to the method of Nature; both the Universal (Macro-Cosmically, the Philosophers' Stone; Micro-Cosmically, the parts of the human body: let there be no slander, however, regarding the restoration of the original form) and the particular things of the lower globe, ALL of them.

**MAGIC** of the most ancient Sages (who were called Magi by the Persians, Philosophers by the Greeks, Wise Men by the Latins, Gymnosophists and Brahmans by the Indians, Priests and *Mekubals* by the Egyptians, Prophets and Cabalists by the Hebrews, Chaldeans by the Babylonians and Assyrians, Druids by the Gauls and Celts, and Bards and Semnothei by others) taken UNIVERSALLY, is the same as the study of the **Cabala** among the Hebrews, highly perfected and absolute, since it consists piously and wisely in the worship of Divine things, the handling of Spiritual things and conversation with them, and the investigation of Natural things: although these [the Hebrews], in one and the same course, with a more kindly Guide, far outran the others.

But, **PHYSICO-MAGIC** (the work only concerning *Bereshith* <note>original: Hebrew *Bereshith* ("In the beginning"), referring to the creation of the natural world.</note>, that is, the Wisdom of Nature, verse 162) is a miraculous method of practicing by Natural artifice (Macro & Micro-Cosmically).

**HYPERPHYSICO-MAGIC** (so called in respect to the Natural and for the sake of teaching) is the pious and useful conversation with good Angels, the flaming ministers of GOD, under the mode of administration delegated by GOD, as much while waking as while sleeping, mediately and immediately.

**CABALA** is the symbolic RECEPTION <note>The word *Cabala* comes from the Hebrew *Qabbalah*, meaning "to receive."</note> of Divine revelation, for the sake of the life-giving recognition of GOD and the Messiah; for the knowledge, union, and enjoyment of the separate Forms, of Nature (in the Macro & Micro-Cosm) and of our very selves; as well as the true understanding of the Holy Scripture (either immediately, or through a convenient medium) by which Divine things are humanly allotted.

There you have it. The necessary and sufficient expositions, in their own time (GOD willing), this *Amphitheater* of ours, philosophically explained, exhibits abundantly to the sons of Doctrine. Be content with these for the present: and do not slander what you do not know. Concerning Magic, Alchemy, and Cabala, a man otherwise sufficiently learned in the more common disciplines (I withhold his name to consult his honor) judged quite meagerly in his poems. *Every person judges a thing according to how he understands it.* <note>original: "Ein jeder iudicirt von einem dinge wie er es verstehet."</note> Such people deserve mercy rather than reproach. I ADD: Someone may ask: From where do you have these things which you propose to us in this *Amphitheater* <note>The author's book, the *Amphitheatrum Sapientiae Aeternae*.</note> of yours? With our Wise One <note>Likely referring to Solomon or a similar biblical authority.</note>, I answer frankly (and indeed all the more gladly so that I may satisfy certain severe critics <note>original: *Aristarchis*</note>, yet I wish nothing to be said by me arrogantly, regarding which I protest in the best and most solemn form of law): **GOD GAVE TO ME: FROM THE LORD I HAVE RECEIVED**: both immediately <note>Directly through divine inspiration.</note> as well as mediately <note>Indirectly through study, nature, and experience.</note>.

But how, I ask, will you inquire again? I shall tell you. You heard before, namely: TheoSophically, Physically, Physico-Medically, etc., as above. For I, inflamed by a great ardor and Divine fire to scrutinize the highest things, have sought out and surveyed the monuments of the philosophers of various nations—the most ancient and the old, as well as the modern—whether they were carved, painted, or written (at home and abroad), symbolically or mystically, hieroglyphically, figuratively, enigmatically, parabolically, allegorically, occultly, secretly, or openly. I did this myself and through others (by purchase or exchange), etc., as time and occasion allowed. 

I have unrolled, reread, and read again the books of the TheoSophers, Cabalists, Magi, and Physico-Chemists (that is, the truly Wise), as well as those of the non-illuminated ethnic philosophers and sophists. With sighs and vows allowed and granted to a Christian, I desired, I invoked, and I prayed. He opened them (the matter speaks for itself)—He who alone is worthy, **IHSVH** <note>A Cabalistic spelling of the name of Jesus, often used by Khunrath to emphasize His role as the source of all wisdom.</note> **THE WISDOM OF THE FATHER**. He opened not only those I have mentioned, but even the **Book of GOD in a triple Universal** <note>original: *ternario Catholicon*</note>, which is: the Holy Scripture, and both Worlds (the Greater and the Lesser) <note>The Macrocosm (universe) and Microcosm (man).</note>. He removed its seals (verse 223 and the second figure of this *Amphitheater*), so that one Book still explains and interprets the other from day to day. 

In the workshop of Vulcan <note>A common alchemical metaphor for the laboratory fire.</note>, from the fifteenth year of my age onward, I have labored untiringly, at expenses (certainly) not small, yet (thanks be to GOD) my own; alone and with companions, some faithful to me and others unfaithful, now skillfully, now clumsily—for how can one do well who has never done poorly? Things that caused harm also taught me. I observed what Nature taught (with Art acting as the midwife). Oh, most fruitful Physico-Chemical Cabala! I diligently noted down the discourses and labors, both my own and those of others, and the concepts of my prophetic mind. 

While you lazy fathers were snoring, I, laboring, stayed awake. I meditated earnestly day and night upon these things which I had seen, read, heard, and learned; standing, sitting, walking, lying down, by the Sun, by the Moon, at the riverbanks, by the streams, in meadows, mountains, woods, and groves; even by the lamp or the wax candle in my chamber (to recreate the animal spirits of the brain), moved pathetically. I lived with and conferred (for I thought it not foolish to learn from anyone) with the old and the young; the religious and the laity (I do not speak childishly or like an old woman, but scientifically); with Princes and those born of high lineage; the learned and the unlearned; the simple and those covered in fox-skin <note>Metaphor for the cunning or deceitful.</note>; the prudent and the foolish; the rustic and the uneducated; with the rich and the poor; with TheoSophers and Theo-Sophists; the good and the bad; the white and the black. I did this for the sake of the science of knowledge, not for approval—for it is not the knowledge of evil, but its use that condemns—with those practiced in theory or contemplation, and those experienced in practice; with...

...with craftsmen, whose workshops I frequently visited; as well with the widely and deeply learned <note>original German: *weit vnd tieffgelehrten*</note>, that is, sailors and miners (for one must believe each person skilled in their own art), as with the highly learned <note>original German: *hochgelehrten*</note>: with Jews, Christians, members of various sects, and even atheists; I heard them all, and I despised none. I put on a good face (according to the most useful counsel of Raimundus <note>Referring to Ramon Llull, a 13th-century philosopher and mystic.</note>) toward those who wander through the world; for I found not a few good things among some of them. To tell the truth, I have experienced more than once that folly sometimes lurks beneath purple, silk, and velvet, while on the contrary, Wisdom is sometimes found beneath a filthy cloak. Do not be ashamed, I advise you, of a wise man who is poor or poorly dressed: help the needy, and you will not regret it. 

TheoSophically, I consulted **GOD**, and I observed Him speaking and responding in the Holy Scriptures, in Nature, and in Myself. By the warnings and guidance of His Holy **SPIRIT**, I possessed the gift of the "discerning of spirits" (1 Corinthians 12:10) and the sense and "discernment of good and evil" (Hebrews 5:14), so that I might hold fast to the Good (which I set forth) and reject the evil (which I have purged away). 

I have traveled long and far; I visited others whom I believed, by confirmed report, to know something through experience and to be strong in judgment, and not always in vain. For **JEHOVAH** being kind to me—moving, disposing, and inclining their hearts—some of them, seeing that they had found a "Son of Doctrine" <note>A traditional term for a dedicated student of alchemy or hermetic philosophy.</note> who was attentive and thirsting for the truth, disputed and conferred with me as friends and without a veil regarding mystical, arcane, and more secret matters. They allowed me to survey their museums and libraries, to contemplate their laboratories, and to watch their labors, and they did so not unwillingly. Those things which they had tracked down over many years with great expense and Herculean labors, they manifested to me fraternally. 

Through the wondrous ordination of **GOD** (I call **GOD** to witness), I obtained from one individual certain prepared substances, among which was the **GREEN LION** <note>original: *Leonem Viridem*. In alchemy, the "Green Lion" often refers to vitriol or a specific acidic solvent used to "dissolve" gold.</note>, a universal medicine <note>original: *Catholicon*</note>, and the **BLOOD OF THE LION**, that is, the **GOLD** not of the common people, but of the **PHILOSOPHERS**. I saw it with my own eyes, touched it with my hands, tasted it with my tongue, and smelled it with my nose: oh, how wonderful is **GOD** in His works! These preparations, I say, they gave to me as a gift, which I have used most fruitfully for my needy neighbor in the most desperate cases; and they sincerely revealed the methods of preparation (by the instinct of a merciful **JEHOVAH**). 

Thus it was necessary, according to the doctrine of Paul in 1 Thessalonians 5:21, to "test all things and hold fast to what is good." Thus it was necessary for me to learn, to study further, and to philosophize: for the smallest part of these things is taught and learned in the Academic Universities. In the University of **GOD**, we must study and learn "Peripatetically"—that is, by walking about <note>A play on the "Peripatetic" school of Aristotle. While that school was named for walking while teaching, the author uses it here to mean traveling the world to learn from nature and experience.</note>. This is the wonderful method which the Wonderful **GOD** gave to me; this is the way in which I walked so that I might *know*, not merely *opine*. (verses 28 and 157.) Who gave this? Only **GOD**, I say, both immediately and mediately: yet by delegation, Nature, Fire, Art, and Masters—both the living and the "mute" <note>Books.</note>, both bodily and spiritual—gave it through my waking and my sleeping. (verses 32 and 157.) 

Therefore, in Christian humility and with a grateful soul, I rightly sing with the Blessed Virgin: *He who is mighty has done great things for me* (Luke 1:49). And I say with the Royal Prophet <note>King David, referring to the Psalms.</note>: *The LORD is compassionate and merciful, long-suffering and of great mercy. A reference to a fragment by the Greek philosopher Heraclitus, suggesting that a soul free from the "moisture" of wine and sensory passion is clearer in intellect.</note> A fat mind tends downward, not upward. **Intoxication** (which the Devil shits into the brains of drunkards) is something more foul than all latrines. verse 79. Nor does **GOD** love any, except him who dwells with **WISDOM**, verse 300.

162 INTERPRETATIONS

**Blessed is the man, who, etc.**] What, I ask, is more blessed than he who finds **WISDOM**? Since in the whole Universe there is nothing more excellent, more outstanding, or more useful than **WISDOM**. The reason is that she gives **GOD**; she gives herself; she makes friends of **GOD**; she appoints Prophets; she gives length of days; honors; riches; **EVERYTHING**. See verses 314 and 315. Who, therefore, among mortals would not seek her, and love her with his whole life? <note>The author uses "her" as Wisdom (Sapientia) is feminine in Latin.</note> May a great "itch" seize the hindmost, and may he be exiled from the threshold of the World. <note>original: "Occupet vltimum magna scabies." This is a playful reference to a line from the Roman poet Horace, meaning "the devil take the hindmost" or "shame on the one who lags behind."</note>

<margin>The gifts and fruits of WISDOM. 317</margin>

| Her acquisition is better than the trading of gold and silver, the first and purest of her fruits. | Verse 14. | For her trading is better than the trading of silver: and her profit is better than gold. |
<margin>317</margin>

**Trading of gold, etc.**] This refers to worldly trading, which is entirely based on finance, moneylending, and deceptive partitioning, etc., established through tireless exertion for the sake of mere pecuniary riches, gold and silver. **WISDOM** is acquired only through mental **TheoSophic** <note>Theosophy here refers to "divine wisdom" or the direct knowledge of God, rather than the 19th-century movement.</note> practice, from Divine inspiration, in both **Oratories**; the fruits of **WISDOM** that are not the least are obtained through the "trading" of manual labors by the Wise man, in the **Laboratory**. <note>The "Oratory" and "Laboratory" represent the two halves of the alchemist's life: prayer and physical experimentation.</note> **Hermes** <note>Referring to Hermes Trismegistus, the legendary father of alchemy.</note> says in Chapter 1: *In so long a life, I did not cease to experiment, nor did I spare my Soul from labor; I obtained this art and this science solely by the inspiration of the living GOD, who deigned to open it to me, his servant.* And a little later: *Give thanks to GOD, who taught you this science (both mediately and immediately), for He loves those who are grateful.* **First and purest, etc.**] For she bestows the **SUPREME GOOD** (the **GIFT OF GOD**) upon the Human who has been reduced—or who is studying to be reduced **TheoSophically**—to the simplicity of the **Monad** <note>The "Monad" refers to the ultimate state of unity or the "One."</note>. This consists of the Recognition, Knowledge, Kinship, Union, and Fruition of **JEHOVAH**, of **CREATION** and **NATURE**, and of **MAN HIMSELF**—that is, **EVERYTHING** universally. In this "three-in-one" consists the more-than-perfect, true, supreme, universal **BLESSEDNESS**, which shall endure fruitfully here and in eternity. For all the mysteries of **GOD** (which He wishes us to know) and the secrets of Nature, every rationale of morals and just Laws, every knowledge of past, present, and future things, gush forth from the inexhaustible fountain of eternal, only-true **WISDOM**. They emanate and are derived into us through the utterances of her Books—the Holy Scriptures—and the wonders of the **Macro** and **Microcosm** <note>The Macrocosm is the great universe; the Microcosm is the human being as a reflection of that universe.</note>. These are wonderfully revealed and handed down to us, heard, seen, and observed by the sons of Doctrine and Discipline. *It is not for every man to go to Corinth* <note>original: "Non cuiuis facilè adire Corinthum." A classical proverb meaning that not everyone can achieve a difficult or expensive goal.</note>, much less to reach the treasury of **WISDOM**! One must Pray **TheoSophically** and Labor wisely: one must run and sweat in the race-course of the Oratory and Laboratory according to the Laws and Doctrine of this *Amphitheater* <note>Likely referring to the author's own work, "Amphitheatrum Sapientiae Aeternae."</note>, in a **Christian-Cabalistic**, **Divinely-Magical**, and **Physico-Chemical** manner. A firm <note>original Greek: βεβαῖον (*bebaion*), meaning secure or certain.</note> reward of victory is decreed for the winner; not for the one sleeping in the sleep of vices or for the lazy.

So too, old age is no remedy for folly.* Since to anyone Divinely illuminated, by the power of philosophical liberty, it is granted to philosophize Theo-Sophically <term>Theo-Sophically: From "Theosophy," meaning "divine wisdom"—a method of searching for knowledge of God and nature through direct spiritual insight.</term>, let each use and enjoy his own Spirit and natural talent. Let each one hear, see, and observe JEHOVAH speaking, teaching, and responding in the Holy Scripture, the Book of Nature, and in himself. Just as no one was ever truly a Pythagorean (as a certain most learned man testifies) who did not perceive the Gods <note>original: "Elohim"</note>; so, I say, no one is a follower of David who has not heard the LORD speaking within himself (Psalm 85, 9); no one is truly a Christian who has not tasted within himself the anointing of the Holy Spirit of WISDOM. GOD is no respecter of persons, but (according to the doctrine of the Universal Religion, verses 184 and 304) in every nation, he who fears him and works righteousness is accepted by him. Acts 10, 35. Therefore do not lose confidence, my son, praying in spirit and truth, and living Theo-Sophically, regarding YOUR own anointing—that is, the anointing of your person—by the Holy Spirit (verse 10). Each of us, by Divine Grace working, flowing, and giving, must and can know (provided he himself wills it in a Christian manner, verse 157) the Doctrine of truth, so that he can admonish and teach himself and others from GOD, and not see only through another's eyes or hear with another's ears. And just as it is useful for everyone to have food stored at home for the sustenance of his body and family, so it is beneficial for everyone to have the Doctrine of Truth ready in the pantry of his Divinely illuminated mind, from which he can provide counsel for himself and others. Behold, my Guardian Spirit <note>original: "Genius"</note> pulls my ear, forewarning me of the backbiting and sniping of nosy fools. What shall I do? Should I keep the truth silent? Far from it: For I know it is the condition of truth that it always has antagonists, stirred up by the devil, who press upon the truth but do not suppress it. Truth <note>original: "Α’λήθεια" (Alētheia)</note> will make fools even more foolish.

Let him who can understand, understand. A huge secret lies hidden here, observed by very few. Would that the fools might become wise by my faithful admonition.

**PRUDENCE & INTEGRITY OF LIFE**, or purity. Indeed, youth itself does not prevent us from being able to discern just as well—or sometimes even a little better—than some foolish elders; for Intelligence comes not from age, but from talent and Divine inspiration. It is not the number of years and a multitude of days that give true Knowledge, but Talent, infused from heaven by the Spirit of the LORD, which provides **WISDOM**, even to little ones: as Elihu, son of Barachel the Buzite, testifies with many reasons in the book of Job, chapter 32, verse 8. Samuel, when he was a small child, received the Spirit of the LORD, 1 Samuel 3. Heroic Wisdom, virtue, and happiness in David were the effects of the special presence of the Spirit of **WISDOM**, the unique operations of the Holy Spirit. For these were not merely gifts of Nature; rather, there was in his mind the Light of the Son of GOD, and in his will and heart the burning movement of the Holy Spirit. He, not yet twenty years old, was anointed by Samuel at the command of GOD and filled with the Holy Spirit (1 Samuel 16, verse 13); where, if all the "wise men" of this unclean world had stood by Samuel, they would no doubt have judged that the elder sons of Jesse would be more fit for governing, just as Samuel himself was initially deceived by outward appearance. But GOD, taking no account of age, nor nature, nor any other fleshly prerogative, handed the kingdom to the youth David; He raised him up, fortified him, guarded him, and helped him, while the other brothers were set aside, whose rivalry David patiently endured. He says of himself in 2 Samuel 23, 2: *The Spirit of the Lord has spoken through me, and his word through my tongue.* And Psalm 119, verses 99 and 100: *I have understood more than all those teaching me: because your testimonies are my meditation. I have understood more than the elders, because I sought your commands.* And verse 130: *The declaration of your words illuminates, and gives understanding to little ones.* Solomon in his youth received **WISDOM**. 1 Kings 3, 12. <note>original: "3. Reg." refers to the Third Book of Kings in the Latin Vulgate, which is 1 Kings in modern English Bibles.</note> Daniel, a boy of twelve years, was filled with the Holy Spirit. To the four boys—Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah (Daniel 1, 17)—GOD gave Knowledge and Discipline in every book and Wisdom; and to Daniel, the understanding of all visions and dreams. And in every word of Wisdom and understanding that the King asked of them, he found them ten times better than all the diviners and magicians who were in his entire kingdom. Sirach says: *while I was yet young, before I went astray, I sought **WISDOM** openly in my prayer; from my youth I sought her out.* Ecclesiasticus, last chapter, verse 18. <note>original: "Eccl. vlt." refers to the book of Ecclesiasticus (also called Sirach), which follows Ecclesiastes in older Bibles.</note> The Apostle Paul does not want Timothy (because he is young) to be despised for his youth, 1 Corinthians 16, 11. <note>The author likely intended to cite 1 Timothy 4:12, where Paul famously tells Timothy, "Let no one despise your youth."</note> And Jeremiah heard from the LORD: *do not say, "I am a child": for to all whom I shall send you, you shall go; and everything I command you, you shall speak.* Jeremiah 1, 7. And in Ecclesiastes 4, 13 it is said: *Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who knows not how to look to the future.* And these examples are indeed drawn from the fountain of Holy Scripture. <note>An asterisk-like mark in the margin suggests a citation or emphasis on the source of these examples.</note> But if it were permitted to range into other examples, good GOD, how great a field for speaking would open itself to us here! But let us bring forward only a few. In Alexander the Great (great in both deed and name), even as a youth there was a wonderful power of Nature, by which he surpassed even the wisest elders in counsel, because of the sharpness of his talent, by which he was able to judge present matters perfectly and foresee future outcomes. When the Venetians had sent beardless youths to the Emperor of the East, and the Tyrant was indignant, as if they had been sent as an insult, one of them fearlessly replied: that judgment should not be passed on men and their learning based on age alone: for if...

It concludes by beginning to offer secular historical examples, such as Alexander the Great, to further prove that youth is no barrier to prudence.</summary>

176                                INTERPRETATIONS

It would be better to be a goat than a man. However, a person whom virtue elevates should not be rejected simply because he is young. It is obvious to everyone, unless they are utterly ignorant of history, what great military leaders of our time, such as *Maurice of Nassau, Sigismund of Transylvania, Don John of Austria, etc.*, accomplished in their youth against older men, due to their unique and innate abilities. For when the supreme Monarch of the World, God Almighty, decides to establish or transfer earthly kingdoms, He raises up instruments to whom He grants authority, that is, Fear, Justice, Wisdom, Counsel, and successful outcomes. No mortal, however powerful, can hinder their efforts. For these heroes are clothed and armed with invincible and supernatural strength. Their deeds and names are inscribed not merely in the corruptible heavens. Therefore, skilled Astronomers (not the common calculating circulators, but those who know the art of the Magi from the East) can seek out and record all truly great deeds with much greater accuracy, even if all historical books were to perish, which may seem incredible to the ignorant. On the other hand, the names and deeds of the Heroes of the Church, whose virtue was powerfully demonstrated in their youth, such as Joseph, Samuel, David, Solomon, and Daniel, are written not in the corruptible heavens, but in the eternal one, where they can be read by all the elect. Therefore, good character is not based on the number of years, nor is age expected in one who shines with virtues and possesses strength. *Valerius Maximus lib. 3. cap. 1. "It is unjust to consider him not yet ripe for honor who is already mature in virtue."* And our age is not entirely lacking in examples. For, praise God, there are still found today some whose intelligence and practical wisdom arrive quickly, even before grey hairs, as Persius sang in Satire 4, "*Young in body, old in mind.*" On the other hand, the Germans say: "*One also finds old fools*," especially since all things are full of fools. Likewise, "*Age does not help against foolishness.*" And, "*The old are twice children*: "Why? Because delusion grows with old age, as the proverb says. "*Grey hairs are understanding, etc."* These are golden words, worthy of note, and should be thrown in the beards of foolish old men who scornfully despise the Theosophically wise and prudent youth. Those who are endowed with heroic gifts display a manly spirit and concern before their years. "*A crown of dignity is old age, etc.*" This is most true, even among the pagans, for as Ovid says, in 6. Fastor.

"*Great was once the reverence for a grey head,*
*And aged wrinkles were of value in themselves.*"

Whose grey head? The wise man responds: That which is found in the ways of justice. Those two, found by Daniel in the ways of injustice, though old, were deservedly stoned. What benefit does old age bring, unless it adds probity and constant integrity to life; unless men grow old with probity and Wisdom? It is indeed, I confess, a rare bird, a truly wise young man; yet he has been found, is found today, and will be found.

*A youth according to his way.* <note>original: "Adolescens iuxta viam." Referring to the training of a child in Proverbs 22:6.</note>] Spirits of wickedness, deceptions, deceit, perversity, lying, pride, lust, wrath, blasphemy, envy, slander, and craftiness infest the minds of children from a tender age. Therefore, unless they are brought up in good discipline, in piety, and in the fear of the Lord, those malignant spirits retain their dominion and their seat in the foolish mind. Indeed, through scandals and stumbling blocks themselves, they migrate and pass into the minds of children. Whence our Savior in *Matthew 18:6* devotes to dire ends those who provide stumbling blocks for the little ones. For just as the malignant spirits are most certainly driven out of the possessed by the power of prayer—especially if the possessed person prays and sighs together from the depths of the heart (for the spirit of darkness cannot long endure such power and a praying spirit)—so truly, by the exercise of piety and divine fear, children are fortified against the hostile infestation of malignant spirits. Therefore, the deceptive and impure spirits strive with all their might to occupy the first seat in a human being, taking root in the will (which is corrupted by natural vice and <term>original sin|the Christian doctrine that humans are born with an innate tendency toward sin inherited from Adam</term>) and in impure affections, before the higher power of a heavenly and pious education can arrive. Then, just as seeds in the fields grow and mature daily until they turn into flowers and fruits, so the seeds of natural vices, if they are not restrained, grow daily and become one with a person's age. In the same way, if the seeds of piety and the fear of GOD are sown in the mind through a proper education, they also grow and turn into the flowers of piety and the fruits of good works.

**He who through the flatteries of the tongue, etc.**] Alexander the Great, distinguishing a flatterer from a faithful minister, said: Hephaestion was a *Philalexandron* <note>original Greek: Φιλαλέξανδρον, meaning "lover of Alexander"</note>, a lover of Alexander; but Craterus was a *Philobasilea* <note>original Greek: Φιλοβασιλέα, meaning "lover of the King"</note>, a lover of the King. And although he loved Hephaestion, he nevertheless held Craterus in greater honor and value. For the former was loved because of flatteries, but the latter was judged worthy of honor because of virtue.

**He who rebukes, etc.** <note>original: "Qui corripientem, &c." Referring to the theme of receiving correction.</note>] Livy, Book 2 of the 3rd Decade: <note>original: "Livius lib. 2. Decad. 3." This is likely a reference to the historian Livy’s *Ab Urbe Condita*, specifically a speech by Minucius in Book 22.</note> "I have often heard," he said, "that he is the first man who can himself take counsel on what is beneficial; the second is he who obeys one giving good advice. **One walking in a straight path, etc.**] That is, one who fears the Lord establishes his path and his life rightly and wisely. However, a despiser of GOD loses his path and his life and exposes himself to the most extreme danger. When the father Telamon told Ajax that he should fight strenuously but seek victory from GOD, Ajax responded like a mad and proud man, saying that even cowards can win with GOD's help, but that he would win even without GOD. **Impious.**] An impious person is one who is a stranger to the knowledge of GOD, a despiser of GOD, or a hypocrite, inconstant in faith. Isaiah 57, verse 20: *The impious are like the tossing sea, which cannot rest.* <note>original: "Impii quasi mare feruens..."</note> An impious person is one who is alienated from the word of GOD in faith, life, manners, and spirit. This is the person whom the just and pious man loathes—the man who has been gifted and illuminated by true faith and transformed into the image of Christ in life, mind, and spirit. For just as the Image of GOD and the image of the devil are in extreme conflict and oppose one another, so the just man, who carries the Image of GOD and Christ, opposes the impious man, in whom is the image of Satan; and vice versa.

# I.
# THE PHILOSOPHER'S STONE

EXPERIENCE, in all matters, even by itself, infallibly testifies that the Philosopher's Stone exists. To contradict it, wouldn't that be more than foolish? A ROMAN PONTIFF and HIS CAESAREAN MAJESTY (although it was prepared by others) saw it working effectively. Kings of the world, not a few, saw it. Several Electors of the Holy Roman Empire saw it, as did some Princes, Counts, Barons, Nobles, and Doctors (regarded as near to nobles on account of their virtue and learning). Moreover, from every nation—Jewish, Pagan, Christian, even Turkish—and from every rank and station everywhere, many people, both Ecclesiastical and Political, learned and unlearned alike, saw it with their own eyes (astonished by Nature's miracle through art) and touched it with their own hands. I speak knowingly.

I quickly name all of them as witnesses: you, who scourge physical chemistry, ask them—to support the truth—ask the lovers of truth. They will gladly testify that this is the case.

2. REASON, true and certain, the faithful guide of the wise, strongly confirms this. But the limited space here prevents me from adding more on that point; another, more ample location, has readily allowed it.

3. SAGES, so many and so great, very important authorities (whose writings about this matter are widely available), have unanimously and harmoniously asserted it with one voice, even with the most sacred oath, and not rashly. All of them are truthful (because they are learned and good men) and have been so and are so considered, until the opposite has been sufficiently proven. But when will that be? Since every craftsman is to be believed in their art, why shouldn't more trust be given to them in this matter than to the ignorant? For all craftsmen know how to discuss, speak about, and judge the rationale of their work both optimally and very truthfully.

4. NATURE, God's ever-busy handmaiden in this world-machine, in many of her operations (as the wise have

### II.
### WHAT IS THE PHILOSOPHER’S STONE?

The **PHILOSOPHER’S STONE** is the **Spirit of God** <note>original Hebrew: "Ruach Elohim"</note> (which hovered over the waters, Genesis 1). It is conceived through the mediation of Heaven (the **LORD** <note>original Hebrew: "YHWH"</note> alone, out of His mere goodness, so willing it), and made into a body—one that is true and perceptible to the senses. It is formed in the virgin womb of the first-born <note>original Greek: "prototokou"</note> created **Chaos** of the Greater World—namely, the empty and void **EARTH** and **WATER**. It is born into the light as a son of the macrocosm <note>original Greek: "makrokosmou"</note>; in appearance (to the foolish) it is vile, deformed, and as if among the lowliest things. Yet, it is consubstantial with and similar to its parent: a small world <note>the "microcosm"</note> (do not imagine anything for yourself regarding man, or anything taken from or by him). It is universal, triune, and hermaphroditic <note>original Greek: "hermaphroditos," meaning containing both masculine and feminine principles</note>; it is visible and sensible to touch, hearing, smell, and taste; it is local and finite. It is manifested regeneratively from itself by the midwifing hand of the physico-chemical art, in its own body, once assumed and glorified. This is for the benefit or **USES**, almost infinite, which are wondrously saving for both the microcosm and macrocosm in a universal tri-unity. 

Begone, then, son of perdition! You, and your **quicksilver** <note>original Greek: "hydrargyron," referring to common mercury</note>, and everything with you that comes from you, however they may be prepared by deceptive arts <note>original: "mangonicè," referring to the "mangling" or fraudulent alteration of materials</note>. You are the type of the sinner, not of the Savior; you can and ought to be saved, but you cannot save. You are a figure of a mediator leading toward error, destruction, and death—not of that good Mediator leading toward truth, growth, and life. There has reigned, reigns, and will reign in natural things, naturally and universally, Na...

### III.
### WHY IS IT CALLED A STONE, AND WHY OF THE PHILOSOPHERS?

Why it is properly called a **STONE**, and what its name is among the common people—those who are blind though they have eyes and deaf though they have ears—**GOD HIMSELF**, for certain reasons handed down in the writings of the high priests of Wisdom, has strictly forbidden anyone to reveal. For this reason, all philosophers would rather have died than divulge it. It is, by the just judgment of **GOD**, always has been, and—with the **LORD** <note>original Hebrew: "יהוה" (YHWH)</note> Himself as the strong and jealous guardian—always will be (along with its dissolution) the most secret **SECRET OF THE ART**, rightly sealed by the Sages with a thunderbolt of excommunication against the unworthy, who are deservedly envied <note>In this context, "invidis" refers to the Sages withholding or being "grudging" with knowledge to protect it from those who would misuse it.</note>. 

Nevertheless, I will quote those speaking philosophically: because, they say, its generation and regeneration is like that of stones; namely, from the moist, the viscous, and the sticky, and from the dry earth. And: because by its cooking (which proceeds by thickening), it is hardened into a permanently fixed stone (and one which may be crushed like a stone). Alphidius <note>An early Arabic alchemist frequently cited in Western hermetic texts.</note> says: "If the stone had a proper name, 'stone' would be its name." Others say: "A stone which is not a stone." These things the philosophers say philosophically. Let a clearer answer remain stored deep in the mind, lest we provoke divine fury against us. 

It is the hidden Stone **OF THE PHILOSOPHERS**, not of the foolish and the unlearned; not of the impious or those who are vicious against their conscience. Furthermore, you are perfectly taught who a Philosopher is—that is, a lover of true Wisdom—in the second part of this *Amphitheater*. I leave you these two axioms to consider, brother: *From the end of every intention results its beginning.* And: *When the causes of a thing are hidden, one proceeds toward their investigation from signs and effects.* Be content with these.

### IV.

### WHAT IS THE SPIRIT OF GOD <note>original Hebrew: "רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים" (Ruach Elohim)</note> WHICH BROODED OVER THE WATERS? Genesis 1.

The **SPIRIT OF GOD** <note>original Hebrew: "רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים" (Ruach Elohim)</note> is the **SPIRIT**, the Breath of Life, the breath of the holy **LORD** <note>original Hebrew: "יהוה" (YHWH)</note>, the Holy One; a Vapor of the power of **GOD** almighty and all-encompassing <note>This imagery is drawn from the Book of Wisdom 7:25, describing Wisdom as a "breath of the power of God."</note>, and a certain **EMANATION**, or sending forth, of vital fertility. It comes from the first and highest mover, life-giving and powerful, from the deepest recess of His own Divinity. It is the storehouse of **IDEAS**—that is, of Models, Species, and seminal, primordial, and radical Principles. These are the master-working wills and effective causes conceived and pre-existing in the mind of the **ARCHETYPE**, the highest creator (within **WISDOM** <note>original Hebrew: "חָכְמָה" (Hhochmah)</note>, in His Goodness, which caused them). These ideas were for all things in the World, which was later to be, to be produced and brought into being. **WHICH IDEAS** (at the command of **ELOHIM** <note>A Hebrew name for God as Creator.</note>, the creator and founder, by His **WORD**, speaking and commanding, Genesis 1) produced and brought to completion all things that He wished to exist in this Worldly Theater. In the sublunary globe <note>The realm of Earth, below the moon.</note>, these ideas were clothed in **EARTH** and **WATER**, the *Hyle* <note>original Greek: "ὕλη" (Hyle); a philosophical term for "Prime Matter" or the raw material of the universe.</note> or first Matter, common and universal, through the intervention of the **HEAVENS**.

I add: the **SPIRIT OF GOD** is the **FORM** <note>original Greek: "μορφὴ" (morphe)</note>, the internal, substantial, and essential shape of all things: the universal **SOUL** of the World. It is a substantial Virtue, subsisting by itself, the cause for every creature in this World to exist. It is a truly **FIFTH ESSENCE** <note>Often called the "Quintessence," the purest element that permeates all others.</note> (because it is uncreated); and (to use the most common word) it is the very substance-giving **NATURE** of things. It is the **DIVINE POWER** and Divine Reason, implanted in the whole World and its parts, the parent and maker of these things. This Spirit of **GOD** is **ONE** (in essence and number); it is the one catholic <note>In the sense of "universal."</note> Soul of this one conspicuous and corporeal Universe. Yet it is **MANIFOLD** <note>original Greek: "πολυποίκיλος" (polypoikilos); literally "many-colored" or "richly diverse," as found in Wisdom 7:22 and Ephesians 3:10.</note>—that is, multiform—and its various rays and **SPARKS** are dispersed and scattered here and there throughout the huge mass of the great bulk of prime matter. They are found in the parts of the world, even those that are disjoined and later separated by location, the mass of the body, and their boundaries, yet they remain distinct—

### V.
### WHAT IS THE SKY? <note>original Latin: *Caelum*. In this context, it refers both to the physical atmosphere and the spiritual "heavens."</note>

The **SKY** is a corporeal **ETHEREAL SPIRIT**, or a spiritual ethereal body, not subject to corruption, permeating the machinery of the entire World. Above, it is fixed by the **WORD OF THE LORD**, and for this reason it is called the **FIRMAMENT**; below, it is incorporated into the whole sublunary mass <note>The "sublunary mass" refers to the Earth and everything below the orbit of the moon, which was believed to be subject to change and decay.</note>. The Sky is one, of one and the same essence and substance, both that which is below and that which is above. That lower portion, however, through the sagacious work of **Physico-chemistry**, can be manifested to the senses and handled for the use of humans.

[Decorative horizontal band with floral and scrollwork patterns]

### VI.
### HOW THE SPIRIT OF GOD <note>original Hebrew: "רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים" (Ruach Elohim)</note>, BY THE MEDIATION OF THE SKY, WAS CONCEIVED,
and became a true body falling under the senses, in the virginal womb of the first (namely, the created **CHAOS**) Greater World—that is, the empty and void **EARTH** and **WATER**?

That extremes cannot be joined, coupled, or united without a middle [term], and a suitable one at that, is the unanimous voice and consensus of those who truly philosophize. The **SPIRIT OF GOD** <note>original Hebrew: *Ruach Elohim*</note> is (in essence) the Divine Spirit: uncreated, most simple, devoid of all corporeal mass, mobile of its own accord and through itself, **manifold** <note>original Greek: "πολυποίκιλος" (polypoikilos), meaning many-colored or diversely fashioned.</note>—that is, multiform or full of forms—indeed, the very **FORM** of things. And the dark **ABYSS** is triune: namely, the **SKY**, the void and empty **EARTH**, and the **WATER**. This is the **BEING** [or Entity] first **CREATED** from nothing by **GOD HIMSELF** (to whom alone it belongs **to create** <note>original Greek: "κτίζειν" (ktizein)</note>)—that is, from no substantial or self-existing material principle. It is corporeal, confusedly mixed, a **MATTER** ineffective for motion by itself: indeed, if anything is, these are extremes <note>The author is arguing that the purely spiritual "Spirit of God" and the purely passive "Matter" are so different that they require the "Sky" as a middle ground to interact.</note>.

Observe now and admire the typical mystery; the conception, I say, of the Savior and Healer of both the Greater World <note>The Macrocosm or the universe at large.</note> and the Lesser World <note>The Microcosm or the human being.</note>, or the human race. I say without blasphemy: in the **BOOK OF NATURE**, and as if in a **MIRROR**, the **PHILOSOPHER’S STONE** <note>abbreviated in original as *LAPIS PHIL.*</note>, the Savior of the Greater World, is a symbolic type of the crucified **JESUS CHRIST**, the Savior of the entire human race, that is, the Lesser World. Know **CHRIST** naturally from the stone, and learn of the **STONE** theosophically from **CHRIST**. I detract nothing here from the Book of **HOLY SCRIPTURE**. A wondrous way of teaching and learning pleased the wondrous **GOD**; let it also please me and you. Let the Christian brotherhood judge, I pray: I also am a Christian, and by the grace of God, I wish both to be and to remain one.

# VII.
# HOW AND WHERE
was the SON OF THE MACROCOSM <note>original Greek: *MAKROKOSMOU*</note> born into the light? He is *despicable in appearance (to the foolish), deformed, and as if among the last of things: of the same substance and similar to his parent, a Little World (not a man), universal, triune, androgynous <note>original Greek: *hermaphroditos*</note>, visible, perceptible by touch, hearing, smell, and taste, localized and finite?*

**WHERE?** In the holy universal earth, which he even now happily inhabits, in the Saturnian kingdom <note>In alchemy, the "Saturnian kingdom" often refers to the deep, dark state of prime matter, or the "Golden Age" of the work.</note>. The SON OF THE MACROCOSM <note>The Great World or Universe</note>, formed from the seed and blood of the parent, and naturally released from its womb into the light. DESPICABLE IN APPEARANCE (to the foolish), DEFORMED, AND AS IF AMONG THE LAST: a laughingstock to the world; yet in the sight of the Wise man, he is most precious. JESUS CHRIST required no other type <note>In this context, a "type" is a symbolic model or prophetic precursor.</note> in Nature. OF THE SAME SUBSTANCE AND SIMILAR TO THE PARENT: because he is from the seed and substance of the parent. UNIVERSAL <note>The author uses the Latin *catholicus* in its original sense of "universal" or "all-encompassing."</note>: according to body, Spirit, and Soul; also in his virtues and operations. He has a Universal BODY, because he is from the seed of the World, from the essence and substance of the first universal Matter, a particle of the primordial and universal matter <note>original Greek: *hyle*</note>, namely earth and water, which were at the beginning of created things. He exists in a state that is still universal, unlike the bodies of all other things in the sublunary globe <note>The realm of Earth below the moon</note> which (as God willed) are specified and—so to speak—particularized by the special rays and sparks of the Soul of the World <note>original Latin: *Anima Mundi*</note>; that is, they are limited to a special or particular property or Nature. His SPIRIT is also of a universal condition, as is his universal SOUL, which is a spark of the universal Soul of the World: Universal, that is, of a Universal Nature, property, and operation. Here, Universality <note>original Latin: *Catholicismus*</note> alone has a place; "particularism" is an error in reasoning <note>original Latin: *soloecismus* (solecism)</note>. The UNIVERSAL MEDICINE <note>original Latin: *Catholicon*</note> of the Physician-Chemists <note>Alchemists</note> comes only from that which is universal. For every like thing is produced by its like. And, "As the seed is, so is the sprout." Therefore, let all special or particular matters, of whatever order, name, or power they may be, be strong and depart far from here (even beyond the Caspian Mountains). A Universal thing is required—

A formula of our **REGENERATION**, both spiritual and corporal; a most perfect mirror of the **SABBATH OF SABBATHS**, which is the clearest image of eternal blessedness: a living **IMAGE** of the mystery of the individual union of the **Most Holy DIVINE TRINITY**.

[Column 2]
*There are in Nature particular powers to which malignant forces yield: why not also to the universal power? Nor can the author of confusion <note>Satan or chaos</note> endure symmetry.*
The **INTELLECT** (*in medical use*) it sharpens and ennobles: thus it also provides a sublime **MEMORY** and **PRUDENCE**. It wondrously excites perpetual **CHEERFULNESS** (in the absence of external violence) and **HONEST AUDACITY** (which is **Fortitude of the Soul**). It is the truest **CATHOLIC MEDICINE** <term>Catholic Medicine: a universal cure-all, from the Greek 'katholikos' meaning universal</term> for our **RESTORATION** and **CONSERVATION**; powerfully driving away all **DISEASES**, both external and internal, whether they be of the Body, of the Spirit, or of the Mind, with **GOD** cooperating—even those which are incurable to **pseudo-physicians** <note>charlatans or those lacking true alchemical knowledge</note>—and preserving the whole man (if he be pre-disposed) even to the term of life predestined for him by **GOD**, vigorous and strong in both mind and body.

[Column 3]
Philosophically, it reduces **BODIES** into **Prime Matter** <term>Prime Matter: the original, undifferentiated substance from which all things are made</term>; (for Prime Matter is the universal animated form) and it renders **METALS** (as I myself have seen), **CRYSTAL, GEMS, PEARLS, FLINTS**, and all **STONES** (even those of the Microcosm <note>likely referring to kidney or bladder stones</note>), as well as **MINERALS**, truly **potable** <note>drinkable, implying they are reduced to a liquid medicinal essence</note>. It frees **ANIMALS** from diseases and preserves them in the vigor of their strength. **VEGETATION** that is nearly dead, it brings back to life when fermented with the specific essence of simples <note>medicinal herbs</note> and methodically applied to them; it restores them by strengthening their **native moisture** (as a permanent universal moisture) and rescues them from imminent destruction (in this instance). In a suitable lamp, its **permanent water** <note>alchemical oil</note>, once artistically kindled, burns permanently forever. And (to conclude many things in a few words) it is miraculously effective upon **ALL** the fruits of the lower globe, as well as the **sublunary spirits** <note>spirits or forces existing between the Earth and the Moon</note>: for all these things naturally obey this **STONE**, for their own weighty reasons.

**FOUR COROLLARIES.**

**1** The **EXPENSES** of this entire work, up to its completion through fermentation (excluding food and clothing), do not exceed the value of 30 talers <note>The taler was a silver coin; 30 talers was a modest sum, suggesting that the "Great Work" of alchemy is not a pursuit restricted only to the wealthy</note>: I speak as one who knows, having been fraternally taught by one who knows. Those who state otherwise are in error.

**2** Just as a tenth part of worldly goods is usually paid to **GOD** for pious causes, while nine parts are for worldly use; so, on the contrary, it befits the **Theosopher** <note>A seeker of divine wisdom through nature</note> to expend only a tenth part of this **Stone** on worldly uses, and the remaining nine parts to **GOD** alone, through one's neighbor who is in need. This is the duty of the almoners <note>Those who distribute charity</note> of **GOD** in this great hospital of the world.

**3** Of **JESUS CHRIST** the crucified, the Savior of the entire human race—that is, the **Microcosm** <note>The "Little World" of the human being</note>—there is a type or reflection in the Book of Nature: the preserver of the **Macrocosm** <note>The "Great World" or Universe</note>, which is the **PHILOSOPHERS’ STONE**. Therefore, from this Stone, recognize **CHRIST** naturally; and from **CHRIST**, learn of the **PHILOSOPHERS’ STONE** theosophically. Thus, the pious and religious Antiquity was made more certain of the promised **Messiah**, even by, in, and from Nature. In this way, a Pagan or a Turk, who values the Most Holy Scripture as nothing (O God!), can be convinced of the truth from the Book of Nature through sense and reason, and (by the cooperation of Divine grace) be converted to Christianity. So too the Jew.

**4** He who has rightly learned the mysteries of the Most Holy Scripture, and also how to read in the Book of Nature and in Himself—and vice versa—he will be a miraculous discoverer of the treasures of **Eternal WISDOM**. For one book explains the other. This wondrous method of speaking and teaching has pleased the most wonderful **GOD**; let it also please me and you. **The Infinite! The Infinite! The Infinite!** <note>original: "Ensoph," from the Hebrew "Ein Sof," referring to God as the Infinite or Boundless source of all light</note>

**THE ENIGMA.**

The **FIRST ALL** in all things delivered to **EVERY** third (from the **FIRST** and **SECOND ALL**) the **FIRST** and **SECOND ALL** in **ALL THINGS**, so that from there he might recognize, know, and possess **ALL THINGS** in **ALL THINGS**, and **ALL THINGS** (universally). What is his name, if you know it? Hear this counsel: Walk in the ways of the Teaching and the Laws of this **Amphitheater**, and **יהוה** <note>The Tetragrammaton, representing the name of God, often rendered as Jehovah or Yahweh</note> will teach you **ALL THINGS** paternally.

**SIMPLICITY IS THE SEAL OF NATURE AND ART.**
I have spoken.

### OF THE WHOLE WORK. 221

The more hidden arts are almost always met with infamy; the envy of "brothers" in similar professions and the study of false ones; indeed, there are tens of thousands of them. Yet, strengthened and animated by the Divine **SPIRIT OF WISDOM and FORTITUDE**, who illuminated my mind so that I might meditate, gave me true confidence so that I might write, opened my mouth so that I might speak, and opens it even now; I have followed where the Fates called. By the guidance and power of this **SPIRIT**, persevering in pious zeal, I have **Theosophically** <term>Theosophically</term><note>Khunrath uses "Theosophy" to mean "Divine Wisdom"—a mystical knowledge of God attained through prayer and contemplation rather than just academic study.</note> overcome all those schemes, so that with **JEHOVAH** supplying the faculties and strengths, I have finally—through weariness, obstacles, and misfortunes, as if through the Red Sea—successfully crossed over, and have emerged safe and sound from the labyrinth of the wandering.

->Behold, I see **LAND**!<-

Therefore, O **JEHOVAH, SPIRITUAL BEING, TRIUNE**, Eternal, Most Wise, Best, Most Powerful, **I AM THAT I AM, THE LORD, THE LORD, GOD, THE MIGHTY GOD, THE STRONG GOD, MY GOD, THE LORD OF HOSTS, THE ALL-SUFFICIENT, THE LORD KING** <note>Khunrath lists a series of Hebrew names for God: EHIEH ASHER EHIEH, JAH, JEHOVAH, ELOHIM, EL, ELOHIM GIBOR, ELOHAI, JEHOVAH ZEBAOTH, SHADAI, ADONAI MELECH. In the Cabalistic tradition, each name represents a different divine attribute or "Sefirah."</note>, Terrible, Truthful, Strong, Zealous, Just, Long-suffering, Merciful, of great Kindness, All-seeing, **FATHER, SON, HOLY SPIRIT**, Creator of Heaven, Earth, Waters, and Founder of **ALL THINGS** which the entire **UNIVERSE** contains: I, **HENRICUS KHVNRATH**, formed as a **MAN** in your likeness; created in Wisdom, Goodness, Justice, Truth, Holiness, Omnipotence, and Immortality (in the first-formed **ADAM**, as all men are) according to your Image; truly one in person, but triple in essences—namely, from an earthly Body, a Celestial Spirit <note>original: "SCHAMAIM," Hebrew for "Heavens."</note>, and a Divinely inspired Soul; and by grace in **CHRIST**, reformed; I give you, the Most High, the most humble and greatest thanks, because you have mercifully heard my prayers, tears, vows, and sighs, poured out most frequently since my earliest youth in repentance to obtain **TRUE WISDOM** from **YOU**; and because out of your pure kindness you have shown me the **TRUTH** of those things with which the present Triune-Universal **Amphitheater** deals. I pray with all my heart for your **MERCY**, that you send me from your holy Heavens the **SPIRIT OF THE WISDOM OF GOD** <note>original: "RVACH HHOCHMAH-EL," Hebrew for the Spirit of Divine Wisdom.</note>, who may always be present with me as a familiar companion, and guide me skillfully...

<meta>This page concludes the "Epilogue or Conclusion" of the work, transitioning from Khunrath’s account of his personal struggles to a final, formal prayer of dedication. ### 222 EPILOGUE OR CONCLUSION OF THE WHOLE WORK.

Let [the Spirit] wisely advise and teach me; let it be with me, let it Pray, let it Work; let it grant me to will well, to know, to be, and to be able in **Physics, Physico-medicine, Physico-Chemistry, Physico-Magic, Hyperphysico-Magic, Cabala <term>Cabala</term><note>Khunrath refers to "Christian Cabala," a Renaissance tradition that adapted Jewish mystical techniques to interpret the New Testament and the "Book of Nature."</note>, and ALL forms of Theosophy whatsoever**: in every action of my life; lest I wander from the path of Truth, and may the Light of Justice shine upon me, and may the **SUN of Understanding** rise in my mind and in my heart. So that to You, O **JEHOVAH**, I may be in good things and toward good ends as a man’s own hand is to himself; I shall follow only the Universal <note>original: "Catholicam," here used in its literal sense of "universal" or "all-encompassing" rather than a specific denomination.</note>, Thrice-triune, Biblical, Macro- and Microcosmic **TRUTH** of your **WISDOM**; and in **ITS** Universal and Thrice-triune Treasury—namely, the books of **Holy Scripture, Nature, and a pure and upright Conscience** <note>The "Three Books" were a common motif in early modern philosophy: God was said to reveal himself through the Bible, the physical world (Nature), and the human soul (Conscience).</note>—may I legitimately find **TRUE WISDOM AND PHILOSOPHY**, and the legitimate manner of **PHILOSOPHIZING** (having been made a friend of **GOD**). By the influence, I pray, by the Light and the Motion of **YOUR SUPRACELESTIAL SUN**, bless my whole being.

Benignly grant me, I beseech You, that with a sound mind in a sound body I may have both the faculties and the strength to lead to a perfectly complete end those things whose true Theory and Practice You have so wonderfully made known to me; may I use them with fruit and most freely, as long as I live, to Your honor, praise, and glory; for the honest utility of my neighbor (according to my Christian vow) and of myself, but for the eternal shame of the devil and his followers. Let there be, O **LORD**, on my right and left, before, behind, above and below, indeed, all around me, my **ANGEL**, your flaming servant, a good spirit, who, under the manner of the administration delegated by **YOU**, shall put to flight the thieves lurking in the region of the air or the malignant spirits, restrain their malice, and defend me from the roaming roaring lion <note>A reference to 1 Peter 5:8, where the devil is described as a roaring lion seeking someone to devour.</note>, lest he devour me, and finally, being surrounded by evil, warn and guard me lest I perish. Deliver me, O **LORD**, from **ALL** evil; and grant that in this way I may pass through temporal things, lest I lose the **Eternal GOODS**; and may I enjoy **JEHOVAH** as Father, Brother, and Friend, for Universal salvation, here and in a most fruitful Eternity: Through and on account of the incarnate **WISDOM OF THE FATHER**, Our Lord **JESUS CHRIST CRUCIFIED**; who lives and reigns in the **TRINITY** as **GOD**, world without end, **AMEN**. From our study, in the year of the Christian era 1602.

                                                                 HENRICUS KHUNRATH
                                                                 OF LEIPZIG, faithful **LOVER OF
                                                                 THEOSOPHY**, and Doctor of
                                                                 both Medicines <note>Referring to his degree in "both" medicines: usually meaning he was licensed in both internal medicine and surgery, or perhaps referencing his dual mastery of physical and spiritual healing.</note>.

[Circular library stamp: HIGHER SCHOOL OF PHARMACY OF PARIS LIBRARY]

He dedicates his scientific and mystical research to the glory of God and the benefit of his neighbor, specifically citing the three sources of knowledge: Scripture, Nature, and Conscience.</summary>

->GREETINGS TO THE SINCERE READER.<-

At the conclusion <note>original: "In calce," literally "at the heel."</note> of the explanations for each grade, sincere Reader, an error has crept in: the following words were included: *Insert here the figure for the first, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, or seventh grade.* In fact, the individual grades do not possess their own separate figures. Rather, the **Amphitheater** <note>original: "Amphitheatrum," referring to the title of the work, *Amphitheatrum Sapientiae Aeternae* (Amphitheater of Eternal Wisdom).</note> itself is composed of its own specific figures and contains its own Introductions. I wished to advise you of this so that you would not think anything was missing from the work. Farewell.

->HANAU<-
->Printed by Wilhelm Anton,<-
->1609.<-
